notes.title: Soulmask is Officially Scheduled for 1.0 Launch in Q4 2025!
notes.content: [h3]Hi Chieftains![/h3][p][/p][p]It's been a while! The question we've been asked the most recently is definitely this one:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/993c7e1aa99695a8a43523e508701a984903961b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/f3af0c0d3163bed164ef7df472caf8650658c39e.png"][/img][i]*Link, we hope you don't mind, but you speak for many. BTW, we really love this meme.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Maggie was taught from a young age that being secretive isn't a good habit! So, Zima and I have decided to share our latest development progress:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Soulmask is officially scheduled to launch its 1.0 version in the fourth quarter of 2025![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Yes, we have re-confirmed the true release date for 1.0. This decision was made after much consideration, but most importantly, we feel there's still some way to go before we reach the complete Soulmask we envision.[/p][p]And on that note, Maggie wants to take this opportunity to give you all a better understanding of Soulmask 1.0! So Zima has decided to join me here for an in-depth chat about everything that will change in the game for 1.0: starting from its core lore, to give you all an early look at what the official version of Soulmask will become.[/p][p][/p][h3]Developer Interview: Soulmask 1.0[/h3][p][b]Maggie: I know many Chieftains are most curious about what exactly Soulmask 1.0 will be. Can you tell us about the biggest changes and highlights in terms of content and experience for the 1.0 version?[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Zima:[/b] Absolutely. In version 1.0, we will be focusing on several key areas to present a new Soulmask to our players:[/p][p][b]First, 1.0 needs to be complete enough:[/b] This is the absolute foundation. We will be refining many of the unfinished parts of the game from the EA version, ensuring that any issues hindering your gameplay experience are significantly improved. This includes aspects like tribesmen, game interactions, balancing, and more.[/p][p][b]Second, Soulmask will be a game built with the goal of being the "ultimate management sandbox."[/b] Many of our new systems are designed for this purpose. You will see a comprehensive integration of tribe management and survival gameplay, allowing you to build a brand-new tribal kingdom.[/p][p][b]Finally, new Chieftains will be able to get started faster:[/b] We want all new Soulmask players to experience its charm as quickly as possible. To that end, we've designed a new, independent tutorial system. We are also trying something more interesting: in 1.0, there will be a brand-new design, something new to ensure your journey in Soulmask is no longer a lonely one and to help you get familiar with this world.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/3bffde5690af00bc28d3153bc3d7325d910dbfe4.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Maggie: What do you think will be the most appealing part of 1.0 for players who haven't tried Soulmask yet? And for veteran Chieftains? How should they re-recognize Soulmask in 1.0?[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Zima:[/b] For Chieftains new to Soulmask, you'll have more choices: [b]we have currently divided the game into three major modes. For sandbox beginners, the Management mode - \[Curious survivors] is the most suitable, providing a more comfortable experience even for solo players.[/b] For those who love the original experience, we have preserved and even enhanced the Survival Mode, offering a more thrilling survival and combat experience. We believe that with these new modes, both our long-time veteran Chieftains and our new ones will find the game even more enjoyable.[/p][p]And for our loyal veteran Chieftains, I personally recommend starting a new save file to experience the new Management Mode. Additionally, we are adding a new gameplay mode called[b] \[Song of the Brave][/b]—perfect for Chieftains who dislike production and construction and just want to focus on combat.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/bd220f2d849291d6e8845b1c1515df98d612a2c4.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Maggie: You mentioned before that Soulmask 1.0 will be the "ultimate management survival sandbox." Can you give us a brief description of the kind of fun we can experience in that regard, Zima?[/b][/p][p][b]Zima:[/b] For that, you might want to take a look at my endgame save file! This is the result of hundreds of hours I've spent in the development build. This base is roughly divided into several sections: a workshop, a rest area, a training area, and a defense area. You could say each one is a microcosm of the brand-new version of Soulmask.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/5973de3cc95d7db7803254b6315ec5447ace4629.gif"][/img][/p][p]Let's start with our core workshop section. Our entire production line, [b]from inventory to the status of each workbench and the assignment of tribesmen, can now be fully managed with one-click operations through a single interface.[/b] At the same time, all equipment and items up to the black iron stage can be fully automated.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/365dad5e22bfa924baf9dfd52d5befabd853455e.gif"][/img][/p][p]And for those minerals and resources scattered far across the world, [b]I've designed a fully automatic, series-connected ropeway system with distribution capabilities: from tribesmen's mines all over the world, all minerals are transported along a ropeway that's over ten kilometers long [/b], powered by windmills, and delivered uniformly to my base. Through this distribution system, my tribesmen sort everything. Sorry, I'm a bit of a perfectionist; setting it up was a bit tedious, but it's incredibly satisfying.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/16846ec11011deefba0f05fe588b2daf8d2af304.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Next is my training area. Compared to our EA version, our tribesmen can now [b]increase their Proficiency in the base[/b], so you no longer need to control them for training in the dangerous wilderness . But we didn't stop there. In 1.0, [b]you'll also be able to have tribesmen acquire the exceptional skills of their companions through training[/b]. I hope this training system will better enable everyone to cultivate their own uniquely powerful tribesmen.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://alidocs.dingtalk.com/core/api/resources/img/5eecdaf48460cde5e76d306615d49d39d2b6e7059bd1128675b8339e1c4c24831b75b38faadcd24bec177c308ebd530461c8c500b27616d079f0b40e3aa1f0695601572d5709fb5dd95f4899853e75ce82e3622f604c66f34fb4c8ed7016461c?tmpCode=ea744776-31f7-45ac-af91-f1a3e444203f"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/1daeefc2e26edd7969f0737236b0b38d39abd594.gif"][/img][/p][p]The rest area isn't very large. Its purpose is to provide my tribesmen with basic food, sleep, and happiness. Additionally, [b]tribesmen can automatically equip their own gear based on the preset templates I've configured[/b]; I no longer need to manage them one by one.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/2ff96a4f4efa491c8e157f79d1c32cbef05a40a8.gif"][/img][/p][p]Finally, there's my defense module. This is also your [b]biggest enemy in Management mode: the three major tribes won't just stand by and watch a new power rise. They will periodically dispatch forces to attack your base.[/b] I've set up a fortified trap city here with automatic turrets. Most of them can't even get past the first winding corridor, let alone the floor traps that follow. It might sound a bit grim, but I quite enjoy personally watching my tribesmen slaughter enemies from the turrets...[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/8717be2f30aca4c2c9cbd69d9a6956f8f7c556db.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]These automated and standardized management elements are all things you will be able to experience in 1.0. As a survival and management player who is also a perfectionist, I hope to share a gaming experience that I myself am satisfied with.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Maggie: Let's talk about something deeper. It's been over a year since Soulmask first entered Early Access. Has the feedback from our Chieftains led to any shifts in our design direction?[/b][/p][p][b]Zima:[/b] In truth, soul, mask, and civilization have always been the themes we wanted to express. Refining tribe and tribesmen management, the expression of the masks, and a deeper narrative for the world are our main priorities now.[/p][p]But we are grateful for all the feedback. The vast number of suggestions we've received since the EA launch has given us a much better understanding of where the Chieftain experience needs improvement. Optimizing that experience is now our most important task, and every feature we develop will serve that goal.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Maggie: Do you feel there are any core product ideas that were part of your original vision, but that most chieftains might not have felt in the EA stage, which you'd like to emphasize and convey now?[/b][/p][p][b]Zima:[/b] If I had to pick one, it would be the expression of the worldview, which was the most lacking element in the EA version. Due to time and cost constraints, the expression of Soulmask's world was very insufficient in the EA version, so it might have been difficult for players to understand what we were trying to convey.[/p][p]The concept of Soulmask ultimately returns to the theme of Awareness, asking "What do people live for?" This was the inspiration for creating Soulmask. Please believe that this game still has a long road ahead. We hope to continue to perfect its narrative and see the final story through together with all of you.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Maggie: Lastly, do you have any final words for the players?[/b][/p][p][b]Zima:[/b] The 1.0 version of Soulmask will be a brand-new experience for fans of both survival games and simulation management games. As fans of both genres ourselves, we've poured many of our wildest ideas into it. This world is just beginning. Once again, we hope you will all join us in exploring it.[/p][p]In the future, the designers for several of our key modules will also chat with you one by one about the specific gameplay details, giving you a more three-dimensional understanding of our game's official version. We would be overjoyed if you end up loving it.[/p][p][/p]

notes.content: [h3]Dear Chieftains,[/h3][p][/p][p]To provide a better gaming experience, the server will undergo maintenance. It will be temporarily unavailable starting from August 21, at 7:00 AM UTC, with an expected downtime 30 minutes. [/p][p][/p][p]Fixed an issue preventing Golden Legend DLC content from unlocking during online play after activation.[/p][p][/p][p]Fixed an issue where using campfire on the elephant deck saddle to revive allowed players to pass through walls.[/p][p][/p][p]Fixed an issue with incorrect positioning of the inverted sloping wall.[/p][p][/p][p]Fixed an issue where the inverted sloping wall could not be placed overlapping.[/p][p][/p][p]The system now displays a reason for why a mask cannot be unlocked.[/p][p][/p][p]Fixed an issue where recruited barbarian invaders lacked Mastery skills.[/p][p][/p][p]Fixed an issue causing Execute to be misaligned at times.[/p][p][/p][p]Tribesman recruitment cap for tribes increased to 1000 (single-player and multiplayer modes). notes.title: Soulmask Heads to ChinaJoy with a Historic Low Price!
notes.content: [h3][b]Hey, Chieftains![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We're thrilled to announce that [b]Soulmask will be at ChinaJoy 2025![/b] Come join us and bring your mask![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/5ba877979a8313c6deb32371ebf8dd27486feab3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]And we believe an event this grand deserves a warm welcome for new players! To celebrate, Soulmask will launch its biggest sale ever, in sync with the start of ChinaJoy. [b]Enjoy a historic 30% off discount from July 31st, 5:00 PM to August 14th, 5:00 PM (UTC)![/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2646460/Soulmask/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Lastly, if you're unable to make it to ChinaJoy to try the game in person, don't worry! The limited-time online demo for Soulmask is still live! Until 12:00 PM on August 8th, you can still experience our first jungle map for free. And don't forget, [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2646460/view/517467843918301050?l=english"]your save data can be carried over to the full game![/url][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]See you at ChinaJoy[/b][/p]

notes.title: 2025 Steam China Showcase Free Demo now live!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hey, new Chieftains![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Thinking of trying Soulmask? The perfect opportunity is coming![/p][p][/p][p]We’re thrilled to announce that from [b]July 23rd, 12:00 PM UTC to July 29th, 12:00 PM UTC[/b], we will be participating in the 2025 Steam China Showcase and offering a limited-time free Demo![/p][p][/p][p]In this Demo version, we will be opening up the initial rainforest area, and in addition to the single-player mode, we will also be launching official PvE and PvP demo servers.We hope you and your friends can experience the thrill of hunting jungle panthers together (or being hunted by them...).[/p][p][/p][p]More importantly, after the demo period ends, the PvE demo server will be converted into a permanent official server, [b]and your characters can be carried over to the full version[/b]—t[b]he same goes for solo play mode![/b] As long as you use the save transfer method detailed below, your progress will be 100% preserved, so you won't have to start building your tribe from scratch![/p][p][/p][p][i]*For the PvP demo server, to ensure fair play, demo characters will not be saved.[/i][/p][p]And if you fall in love with Soulmask during this short but thrilling demo, we've got the best purchase price for you: During the 2025 Steam China Showcase, our Soulmask Game + Original Soundtrack bundle will be on sale at a historic low discount of [i][b]30% off![/b][/i] Making it easier for you to continue the jungle adventure you've just begun![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53084/7/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Finally, welcome to this savage world—put on your mask and join us![/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Appendix: solo play Mode Character Transfer Method:[/b][/p][p][i]*For players enjoying the solo play mode, after the demo ends, you can continue your adventure in the full version by moving the Soulmask Demo save file (located at C:\\Users\\YourUsername\\AppData\\Local\\WS\\YourSteamID\\2654630\\AutoGames)[/i][/p][p]

notes.title: Soulmask Game Crash Solutions
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/31816ad03666d50ce71709286b27cb90ef88c155.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Recently, we have received feedback from players about game crashes. If you are experiencing a game crash, please try the following methods to resolve the issue:[/p][olist][*][p]Update your graphics card driver to the latest version.[/p][/*][*][p]Update the game to the latest version and verify the integrity of the game files.[/p][/*][*][p]Uninstall the game, try changing the installation disk, and re-download it to prevent crashes caused by disk issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Launch the game in safe mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Try closing unnecessary software (such as Cheat Engine, antivirus software, or programs that may modify memory).[/p][/*][*][p]For NVIDIA users, try disabling DLSS (Deep Learning Super Sampling).[/p][/*][*][p]Attempt to limit the frame rate, lower the resolution, and reduce graphical settings to decrease overall power consumption and prevent restarts caused by power supply issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Delete all local Mod files.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h3][b]Notes:[/b][/h3][p]Even high-end gaming PCs may experience crashes due to differences in hardware configurations and software environments. A minor compatibility issue or specific setting could cause instability.[/p][p]If the above solutions do not resolve your issue, we kindly request you to send the following information to our support Email: [/p][p][url="https://soulmask@qoolandgames.com"]soulmask@qoolandgames.com[/url][/p][list][*][p][b]Detailed problem description[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Game Crash Folder (Crashes)[/b] (located in: C:\\Users\\\[YourUsername]\\AppData\\Local\\WS\\Saved\\Crashes)
[i](Note: The "AppData" folder may be hidden. How to show hidden files: Open [b]File Explorer [/b]from the taskbar. Select [b]View [/b]> [b]Show, [/b]then select [b]Hidden items[/b] to view hidden files and folders. [/p][p][/p][p][b]The update details are as follows:[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Portal preferences would disappear after saving and reloading in single-player mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a building detection limitation when opening the mount's inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]In PvP, players cannot use portals while the deployed companions are engaged in an interaction.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing bow mastery skills to deal excessive damage if used after a standard charged shot.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where combining Single Blade Dash Slash with Overload, Roll, etc., could cause the character to be flung an abnormal distance.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Longbow's Golden skill to properly bypass Shield DMG Immunity and drain Stamina from defending targets. Targets now enter a "Guard Break" hitstun when Stamina is depleted.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved controls to allow entering the Bow charging state by holding the key during certain actions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, after running out of arrows and then acquiring more, the Bow Mastery skill could not be used until after a normal attack with the bow.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing the Dual-Blade Mastery "Sideway Slashes" to grant permanent invincibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with clipping through terrain when using the Power Ropeway.[/p][/*][*][p]Power Ropeway connections are not allowed to pass through other players' bonfire range.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Great Sword Mastery 2[/b] - Strike Slash has been adjusted to: Knocks down the enemy by slashing their legs and retreats a small distance. Press the basic attack button again at this time to perform a powerful leaping slash, dealing critical damage and putting the target into a Coma.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Great Sword Mastery[/b] - Assault has been adjusted to: Quickly charges at the target for a surprise attack. Every third use of the skill unleashes a rapid thrust combo. Landing three consecutive hits on the same target will shatter most of their Superarmor.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Great Sword Mastery[/b] - Butcher has been adjusted to: A series of heavy slashes, like butchering animals. Each hit briefly reduces the target's DEF by 20% (stacks up to 3 times). Landing 4 consecutive hits will put the target into a brief coma. Gains a temporary 20% ATK boost (stacks up to 4 times) if attacked while using this skill.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Great Sword Mastery [/b]- Salted Fish Stab has been adjusted to: Thrusts forward with all might, dealing a great amount of damage and putting the enemy into "Disarray" for 10 seconds. While affected, the target has a 50% chance to miss their mark with every strike. (Does not affect bosses)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Great Sword Mastery[/b] - Counter Lifesteal has been adjusted to: Grants status: While active, performing basic attacks with a great sword gains Superarmor; when attacked, automatically counterattacks the attacker and converts 30% of the damage deal into healing (this lifesteal effect will increase to 60% if the target is NPC); when attacking with a great sword, converts 10% of damage dealt into healing.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Single Blade Mastery [/b]- Turn Slash has been adjusted to: Concentrates strength on the right arm before unleashing a fatal slash that deals a great amount of damage to the enemy. If used by a player, the target is also prevented from locking onto other players for 10 seconds. Afterwards, the unit and any allies within 5 meters become untargetable and elusive to all ranged weapons for 10 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gauntlets Mastery [/b]- Revolving Kick and 2-Strike Kick now have a "fast approach" effect when used within 10 meters of the target.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gauntlets Mastery[/b] - Slip Punch has been adjusted to: Effect lasts 50 seconds: While active, normal attacks turn into special punching attacks after dodging. With each dodge in a different direction, followed by a punch, the unit gains a stack of fast stamina recovery. Dodging repeatedly in the same direction removes the recovery effect. Using a Forward Punch within 5 seconds of a Rear Punch ignores the target's DEF. Using a Rear Punch within 5 seconds of a Forward Punch breaks most of the target's Superarmor. Using a Left Punch within 5 seconds of a Right Punch (or vice-versa) grants 5 seconds of Superarmor and a 10-second Resilience Down buff that drains an extra 10 Resilience from the target per hit. Agile footwork is the key to a relentless assault. (CD: 60s) (Note: All directional Punches now have a "fast approach" effect when used within 20 meters of the target.)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gauntlets Mastery[/b] - Defend has been adjusted to: Takes up a defensive stance to fend off enemy attacks. This can be executed without ending the defensive state. Blocking an enemy attack drains the attacker's Resilience and boosts the user's damage for the next 5 attacks, during which basic attacks become Ultra Quintuple Fist and ignore the target's DEF. If the user blocks a projectile like an Arrow or Throwing Axe, they will catch and hurl it back at the attacker (the unit is immune to any damage during the throw-back), dealing damage and knocking them down.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new Gauntlets Mastery skill - Earth-quaking Strike: Leaps into the air and slams down with thunderous force, knocking enemies airborne. Enemies who fail to block this attack will be unable to recover HP. (Does not affect Bosses)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hammer Mastery[/b] - Lament of Earth-splitting has been adjusted to: While active, Crit DMG +20%. Using a normal hammer skill will inflict additional earth-splitting damage to the target and knock them down.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shield Mastery[/b] - Get Poised Before Strike has been adjusted. The bonus ATK now lasts for a set duration after dealing damage, instead of being cleared on the next hit.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Spear Mastery[/b] - Spear Leap Stab has been adjusted to: Leaps forward and delivers a fatal airborne strike, dealing massive damage and inflicting a 5-second debuff on the enemy, causing them to take 1% of their Max HP as extra damage (up to 200) and lose 10 Resilience each time they are hit.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Spear Mastery [/b]- Overturn now deflects all arrows and thrown weapons that are coming from the front, sending them back to the attacker and dealing damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new Spear Mastery skill - Terrorizing Lunge: Leaps forth, striking the enemy with a spear, dealing damage and stunning them. Gains 100% additional Crit Rate for the next 2 seconds.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Anniversary Update: "Golden Legend" DLC & Tribal Automation
notes.content:
[h2][b]Let's get started, Chieftains![/b][/h2][p]
Right now, discover the brand-new Mask from a mysterious civilization, and lead your tribe into a new era!

Our anniversary gift to you:[b] the new DLC "Golden Legend" and the major Tribal Automation" update are now officially live.[/b]
[/p][previewyoutube="q-4ofULAgdQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
If you haven't experienced the game yet, Soulmask's record-low 30% off discount is our most sincere offering for this anniversary and[b] the best time for you to jump in![/b]  https://store.steampowered.com/app/2646460/Soulmask/  More importantly, new Chieftains equipped with the "Golden Legend" and the new automation gameplay will be able to establish their tribes and influence faster than ever!  Looking back on the 365 days of Soulmask we have been very lucky to have [b]over 630,000 Chieftains[/b] join us in this new world, your support is our most valuable asset!

So, on this special anniversary, we've prepared a wealth of community content: from rewarding community events to an officially collaborated Ancient East community Mod, all part of our "birthday party." Experience the most vibrant Soulmask community with our amazing community members!

I know you can't wait to dive into our brand-new anniversary content, but please allow Maggie to introduce this update's gameplay properly—it's going to be a wondrous journey.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]New Civilization DLC: Golden Legend[/b][/h2][p]
[/p][h3][b][i]"When the new dawn breaks, may this Mask awaken dormant wisdom, choosing the worthy to rekindle the flame of civilization."[/i][/b][/h3][p]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3731990/DLC/

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/6e149663cb5d7a9b34e9c32d3628799476b81f90.png"][/img]As one of the inhabitants of this wild land, other masks are closely tied to the ancient beliefs you've known since birth—some are ferocious, some majestic, some resilient; they are extensions of the Chieftains' power, manifestations of your will.
But you heard a call carried by the sea. You dived into the water and retrieved this mysterious mask from abandoned wreckage: the [i][b]"Golden Legend"[/b][/i] 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/76d8a822baa21630b321f85326cf4d0bb082609e.jpg"][/img]It seems so out of place—the moment you touched it on the seabed, you felt the aura of a mysterious new civilization emanating from it, entirely different from anything you knew—Sunbird, Golden Sacred Tree... When you wear this mask, you always hear these unfamiliar echoes from a civilization beyond the shores...

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/6c96c1bc0daa8443ca6a5cd9dd2387df8872c4d3.jpg"][/img]The "Golden Legend" will be the first mask you acquire that is entirely specialized in identifying and recruiting exceptional barbarians. The \[Bone Discern] and \[Spirit Sight] powers of the "Timekeeper" from the Sunbird allow you to see the full potential of every barbarian—whether their future lies as a valiant warrior or a nimble artisan, it's clear at a glance.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/287504fd08eb03e1b8da4992d4f247ec89464267.gif"][/img]And the "Golden Legend's" mimicry ability, \[Reincarnation], allows the Sunbird "Timekeeper" to return to this world, attaching to your being: all qualities and titles of barbarians will be presented before your eyes with utmost clarity. Who is strong and who is weak will be self-evident.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/d986c7af51248a60f40f0f022b6f5ec8ea6c9055.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/a6138215cb6e0b2d720170d029f46c562e8ec987.jpg"][/img]While in mimicry, you can bring forth the blessings of the "Sunbird," lost for a thousand years, back into the world—it will accurately locate those rare barbarians possessing extraordinary skill potential. And when you mark any barbarian you've taken a liking to, the Sunbird's blessing will protect these chosen talents from being accidentally killed by your hand.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/c251e6e3e063f72ae4ab7455505a7611d1b8d880.gif"][/img]It will be a mysterious mask that allows you to perfectly command all your subordinates. The abilities it possesses make you instinctively ponder the mysterious civilization behind it. What exactly is it? [i]Why did it appear in your world? And what stories unfolded there?[/i]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/a105d4153d929b717cae628e4e2273f8e097d778.png"][/img]You do not yet know the answer—for the mysterious civilization of the Golden Sacred Tree, the "Golden Legend" is clearly just the tip of the iceberg. You've found several uniquely shaped decorative item blueprints in the mask's database; you can even imagine their glorious appearance a thousand years ago.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/515c02cfacbb43b4d9b0ab5c26465d9d24a138b6.jpg"][/img]But undoubtedly, the "Golden Legend" will completely change the way you govern your tribe, and more of their stories will perhaps only be unveiled later...
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]New Upgrade: Tribe Automation[/b][/h2][p]
As your tribe grows, so does your desire for increased productivity. And so, it has arrived: [b]A fully automated logistics system![/b]

[b]Power Ropeway[/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/0d8273d21655d5f1b7c29edcda18187c3ec71886.jpg"][/img]Introducing our brand-new "Power Ropeway": Now, automated wind-powered transport hubs will allow you to fully automate all your material transportation! Simply set up base stations at the start and end points[i] (typically between your base and a mining site)[/i], construct the intermediate cableway hubs, and establish a power source at the origin—your Power Ropeway is ready!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/c35805289e079938fc9fca667011d4f27825475e.gif"][/img]Next, schedule the regular transport of needed minerals and let your tribesmen handle the automatic conveyance of raw materials. You'll have a constantly flowing supply line delivering resources right to your tribal camp—[b][i]NO MATTER the distance![/i][/b]

And as for ore extraction right from the source, we're making that completely automatic too. The new "Power Mine" structure can be built near ore deposits. Provide it with windmill power and assign a diligent tribesman, and it will integrate into your logistics network, continuously supplying your tribe with all sorts of ores.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/f95dcd8b5c1b2b05b25da47acf005daca3c4cd1b.gif"][/img]You can even use it as a fast travel tool, or soar through jungles and across mountains with your friends. Technology changes lives, folks!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/4f9364de1459cc2b961d41f58fed70b97828a144.gif"][/img]
[b]Pre-Building[/b]
When planning your constructions, you can now forget about material limitations—let your tribesmen do the building for you! In the new version, when using the \[Construction Hammer], you can directly engage in "pre-building": place the architectural framework wherever you desire. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/98757aebfcda69c04451207922082fd779e7b520.gif"][/img]Next, assign your tribesmen as builders; they will retrieve the construction modules from storage (if they're out, you can have other tribesmen craft them!) and automatically complete the construction. This means you're free to focus on other, more critical tasks!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Anniversary Celebration![/b][/h2][p]
Yes, Soulmask has officially hit its one-year milestone since entering Early Access! In addition to the previously mentioned [b][url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2646460/announcements/detail/517463149097518995"]Steam anniversary gifts[/url][/b], we've also prepared some exciting commemorative activities to ensure that both new Chieftains and the loyal veterans who've journeyed with us can thoroughly enjoy this special occasion!

[b]Official Collaboration Mod:[/b]
This marks our first venture into official community content collaboration! The debut "Ancient East Building Parts" mod, a joint effort between @leesiontoo and the Soulmask official team, is now live on the Steam Workshop! Perhaps this pairs perfectly with our "Golden Legend"! Getting this Mod is super easy—just click here to subscribe!

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3486111012&searchtext=
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/cf7639b8b9cd2ee3453211125abf44b34c904d57.jpg"][/img]
But more importantly, we plan to continuously collaborate with community content creators to deliver even more high-quality Mod content. If you're interested in becoming one of our collaborators, please reach out to Maggie or Laura on [b][url="https://discord.gg/ucmMxeWHpZ"]Our official Discord[/url][/b]!

[b][url="https://discord.com/channels/1160486185840418927/1160537278456791052/1380079185078517830"]Golden Legend Snap Discord Event[/url][/b][url="https://discord.com/channels/1160486185840418927/1160537278456791052/1380079185078517830"]
[/url]
The long-awaited Discord community event has finally arrived! We know you can't wait to put on your new mask and experience the mystical aura of an Ancient East high priest! Fun is better when shared—team up with friends, take group photos in-game, and claim the black 'Diving Loong' skin for FREE! 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png"][/img]We hope you'll love our anniversary gifts! [b]The 1.0 version of Soulmask has now officially entered its final development phase[/b]. In the days to come, please keep a close watch on our community updates. The first wave of 1.0 content will be arriving shortly, and as always, it will be your host Maggie bringing you all the details! Stay tuned!

[b][i]See you soon![/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: Soulmask Early Access Regular Update 48
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Chieftains,[/h3]

「When the new dawn arrives, may this mask awaken sleeping wisdom, and choose the worthy to reignite the flame of civilization.」

Resting deep beneath the seabed ruins, the Golden Mask's divine eye emits a subtle glow, yearning for you to unveil its ancient splendor.

This update introduces the  "Golden Legend" DLC, an arcane mask from a distant Eastern civilization which can bring profound transformation to any tribesman! 
Additionally, a new Tribe Automation system will elevate your clan's operating efficiency to unprecedented heights!
Use swift pre-building techniques and the Power Ropeway to quickly transport supplies and personnel, spreading your tribe's influence to the entire world!
Come join us during this grand anniversary event! New civilizations, new masks, and new possibilities await your discovery!

To provide a better gaming experience, the server will undergo maintenance. It will be temporarily unavailable starting from June 5, at 7:00 AM UTC, with an expected downtime 30 minutes. This update includes a client update, and chieftains will need to update their client to enjoy the game normally. We are very grateful for your understanding and support.

The update details are as follows:

[h3][b]【Adjustments and Bug Fixes】[/b][/h3]

Added new DLC exclusive Mask - Golden Legend.

Added new DLC exclusive Skin - Rising Moon.

Added new DLC exclusive decorative buildings: Mysterious Bronze Man, Scared Bronze Tree.

Added a Shipwreck Area.

Added new veins for Copper Ore, Tin Ore, Iron Ore, and Coal Ore.

Added a new building: Power Mine, which can be placed atop veins.

Adjusted underwater breathing values.

Adjusted breathing recovery values using Roasted Mushroom, Mushroom Soup, and Psychedelic Pot.
Life Perception can now detect veins.

Fixed abnormal bow-drawing animation during quality assessment.

Added distance info to scout guide icon. Interrogating a scout now reveals local portal details.

In the Wetland region, copper & phosphate mines are now iron. In the Wild Plains, copper mines are now phosphate.

Added a new building: Power Ropeway

The Construction Hammer now has a pre-build feature. When equipped with Construction Hammer, pressing "B" will open the construction list. You can select any building part to design a ghost structure within the bonfire range. Once the design is complete, you can assign tribesmen to auto-build the building part and procure materials for it.

Added a new tribesman work type: Construction Procurement.

Added new furniture: Weapon/Gear Rack

Repair Bench now supports auto-repair function with tribesman.

Uncrafting Table now supports auto-uncraft function with tribesman.

Added construction modules: quadrilateral pointed roof, half-height quadrilateral pointed roof, and spiral staircases.

Camp Upkeep Tribesmen will now repair broken windmill blades.

Added metal windmill blades.

notes.title: Our First Anniversary: New Masks, New Tribes, A New Soulmask
notes.content:
[h2]One year, Chieftains![/h2][p]
That's right—365 days have passed since our Early Access launch, and Soulmask has journeyed alongside all of you! As our first survival game on Steam, Maggie and the rest of our development team have spent this year in a constant mix of anxiety and excitement. Many of you might still remember that somewhat incoherent report we published just 72 hours after launch. Indeed, facing the flood of feedback from Chieftains at that time, we had moments where we wondered if we might have "messed things up." But fortunately, each of you supported Soulmask and every one of us with absolute tolerance and enthusiasm.

We all agreed that we couldn't let down your support over this past year, so Soulmask has prepared an anniversary gift—what we believe best represents the core concept of Soulmask: [b]a special free DLC[/b] featuring a brand-new mask representing an alien civilization, along with new automation features that will truly transform your tribe into a powerful machine.

[/p][previewyoutube="q-4ofULAgdQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[/p][h2]New Free DLC: Lost Civilization[/h2][p]
[b][i]Golden Visage, bright through ages, dazzling now.
The Star-Seer's own; it pierces the Nine Depths, touches celestial crowns.
A vigil of a thousand years.
——From an unknown civilization's tablet found beneath the sea[/i][/b]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/8f686a5da7a3928d3a054decc60a5a4b6546d4ff.gif"][/img]
Meet "[i]Golden Legend,[/i]" Soulmask's first mask DLC. [b]A mask lost beneath the ocean for a thousand years,[/b] along with the mysterious decorations of its vanished civilization. From the moment you touch it, you know it's different from all your other masks: there's no familiar echo of barbarian souls. Instead, it brings you something more... otherworldly, a mismatched civilization from distant shores.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/0eca4f295211553a691df3b3798897316c1e6221.jpg"][/img]Through it, the figures of your tribesmen become clearer. No longer just their bravery or cowardice—you can faintly sense the potential deep within their souls. [b]Who is the true blade? Who is the most skilled craftsman?[/b] The barbarians' secrets are no longer hidden from you.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/106e226bc4d3b685b7104853f5cec1218a060e42.jpg"][/img]It holds many powers yet to be discovered. Where did it come from? Why was it found in that ocean corner? What civilization lies behind it? You know nothing, but it will completely change how you rule your tribe.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/ae41c88a6f031692ec617b6a18e99c84a4872010.jpg"][/img]Yes, t[i]here's much more we could tell you about "Golden Legend,"[/i] even about the entirely new civilization behind it. We'll release a dedicated introduction for it soon. But without doubt, it represents just the tip of the iceberg of Soulmask's ambitious vision.

[/p][h2]Automation: From "Tribe" to "Empire”[/h2][p]
Tribe management has always been Soulmask players' favorite part, but we're still not satisfied with our current management system. As we've said before, if Soulmask's goal is to be "the ultimate management-focused sandbox survival game," our current management system can obviously be improved.
So, on our EA anniversary today, you can see the first step of this blueprint: [b][i]Construction and Transportation[/i][/b]—the two issues Chieftains care about most. Today, on our anniversary, we finally have an automation solution that satisfies us.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/c9ad31312794bed58bdf464d1c3b902d8e027718.jpg"][/img]
First, welcome to experience the powered ropeway system. [b]Power from windmill arrays can be directly input into these robust cables and pulleys,[/b] creating cargo transportation channels spanning camps, mines, and everywhere in between.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/0d8273d21655d5f1b7c29edcda18187c3ec71886.jpg"][/img]
With powered ropeways, plus your clever building creativity and route planning, your tribe will no longer be limited to small primitive camps. They could potentially become logistics hubs spanning the entire map (provided you protect them well, of course!). But once established, your barbarian tribe—or even the embryo of a barbaric Empire—will gain a crucial piece of the puzzle.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/cad3048ff19b0bc4523fa56c4a6c431734eab1d2.jpg"][/img]
Then there's construction. Our developers unanimously agreed that a great tribe's Chieftain [i]shouldn't need[/i] to manually build every foundation and ceiling. So we've listened to your voices and let tribesmen handle it all: the building filling function lets you freely pre-build construction shadow, having tribesmen gather materials, produce components, and then automatically construct everything.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/93c37a11181c03b86efc8186d1ae48fea4125887.jpg"][/img]
This allows Chieftains to more easily build desired structures in new camps, let the tribesmen there complete the remaining work, and then—you do whatever you want, handle your own business!

Like "Golden Legend," we'll provide more detailed systematic introductions in the coming days. But you'll experience this immediately: on [b]June 5th[/b], you'll "unwrap" this anniversary gift. Take a peek—we hope you like it.

And naturally, at this special anniversary moment, we need to chat with our producer ZIMA about our overall vision: [b]What kind of game will future Soulmask be?[/b]

[b]Yes, now let's bring out our producer ZIMA to take over the following section![/b]

[/p][h2]About the Future: The New Soulmask[/h2][p]
Greetings, Chieftains. I'm ZIMA, it's been a while.

The last time we met should have been in[b][url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2646460/announcements/detail/6189715263295870593"] this article [/url][/b]where we discussed initial character issues (link). A year has flown by in the blink of an eye. With the support and feedback from all you Chieftains, Soulmask is getting closer and closer to its complete form.

Maggie has actually already discussed [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2646460/announcements/detail/591768182357754562"]our 1.0 information here[/url], but I still hope to briefly chat about future Soulmask using our anniversary gift: through them, you can see part of what we truly envisioned from the very beginning—what future Soulmask will look like.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/da9c52a5973995534cdb72943ca67c3ac19a83b9.png"][/img]

[b][url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2646460/announcements/detail/4191240933898343704"]In the letter[/url][/b] I sent at the beginning of Early Access I mentioned the concept Soulmask yearns to explore with players: the mysterious mask capable of "consciousness uploading" as a possibility for civilization development:

[/p][h3][b]Through masks, what is civilization's endpoint? Besides this tribal world, are there other mask civilizations?[/b][/h3][p] This question is what we hope to let Chieftains truly experience in Soulmask's gameplay—the truth of this world. As mentioned before, Soulmask has three concepts that occupy important parts of the game—【Masks】, 【Tribes】, 【Civilizations】:  [/p][p][/p][p][b]【Civilizations】[/b]: Different "lost civilizations" will be one of future Soulmask's core themes. "Golden Legend" clearly shows everyone the style of another mask-dominated civilization: different civilizations obviously vary greatly in the role masks play within them and their ability to use these magical artifacts.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/3b16534da94a01cbd2d845a132e64cf4db9daab6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]【Tribes】[/b]: Chieftains who obtain multiple masks will eventually embark on a unique tribal growth path. Pre-construction and logistics transportation are just the beginning—the connection between tribal members and each of you will become increasingly closer, ultimately becoming a new civilization exclusively yours.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/d17606fd624977386fdddd501e340812cbee83fa.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]【Masks】[/b]: Yes, masks—mysterious creations. "Golden Legend's" special abilities will make you can't help but imagine more. Their secrets seem not yet fully explored: What other capabilities do they have? How many civilizations have they influenced? As carriers of consciousness transfer, might they still harbor some...[i][b] consciousness other than yours?[/b][/i]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/17cd559fb2c2c07e621a11c954c89e4203a5b419.gif"][/img][/p][p]Maggie and I will discuss the true appearance of[b] Soulmask 1.0 in more detail after some time.[/b]

However, beyond our own vision for Soulmask, Soulmask's 1.0 will still have another equally important content: responses to feedback and support from all of you. This game is a collaborative work between all of you and us.

[/p][h2]Looking Back: Thank You ALL[/h2][p] Honestly, the process from a game's conception to a complete work requires a difficult and lengthy journey, and our choice of "Early Access" makes this even more so.  Even though we had prepared sufficient expectations, from the first day of Soulmask's Early Access, we received tidal waves of opinions from Chieftains. I personally have vivid memories of feedback from[b] @Periwinkle[/b]: he clearly loved Soulmask and believed we "had all the elements of a great game." But he was indeed defeated by dissatisfaction with the initial character—his opinion, representative of many Chieftains' views on initial characters, was also an important reason I decided to write that separate article. I want to tell [b]@Periwinkle [/b]that we improved initial character strength early on in our first major update "The Evolution of Mask" If you can see this, welcome back!  Of course, what made me even happier were the first batch of Chieftains who liked Soulmask during Early Access and gave us precious positive reviews. We can't thank each of you individually, but I need you to know this is the primary reason Soulmask has persevered until now.  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/893a481442b556ed8e81b191ee3f5cbb305f6983.png"][/img][/p][p]Especially those Chieftains who spent enormous effort giving us lengthy positive reviews, like [b]@VeronaKate, @Heitri,[/b] and [b]@Bleddy[/b] (by the way, Bleddy, tribesman tools are more intelligent now! You should come back and try it). I have a particularly strong impression of [b]@~MysticalKitty~'[/b]s supplementary comment. She and her husband were troubled by enemies constantly spawning around barbarian camps. After we fixed it, her additional praise made our development team incredibly energized: such recognition of our modification work gave meaning to our nightly hard work.  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/46dc629c6185ad060aa8085e3193ca24c112999b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Yes, "The Evolution of Mask" could be said to be our first update collaborating with all of you to perfect Soulmask. After that, we began meeting more of your demands for new content: [/p][list][*][p] For instance, [b]@Kira Simone[/b] mentioned furniture, buildings, and other functional—or decorative—structures. I think the little gadgets we've added across several consecutive updates and DLCs should keep you entertained for a while (though of course, this is far from enough).; [/p][/*][*][p] We heard [b]@indigo46n2[/b] complain about insufficient map content density, so we tried adding world events and wild bosses in the major "Wild Ride" update. We believe world events will become a system Soulmask continues to deepen. [/p][/*][*][p] Regarding flying mounts that[b] @mBBbasar, @chelle[/b], and others in the Steam community asked about, we've already updated with flying gliders. And there are even more impressive things coming afterward—trust me. [/p][/*][*][p] And Chieftains like [b]@Ramenx[/b] who are very enthusiastic about community mods—received! We've opened the Workshop, and now 200+ community content pieces let you freely combine your preferred Soulmask world. [/p][/*][/list][p]I futilely attempt to mention everyone who provided valuable feedback in this article, but obviously this is an impossible task. I just want to say one thing: current and future Soulmask are developed together by us and all of you. This world belongs to everyone.


And certainly, Soulmask's 1.0 won't be the end either. [b]We'll persistently perfect this work, making it more excellent and more worthy of everyone's support.[/b]

[/p][h3][b]Once again, thank you everyone![/b][/h3][p]
We'll meet again soon—[i][b]a new Soulmask is coming.[/b][/i][/p]

notes.title: Soulmask 1.0 Roadmap & The First DLC Official Reveal
notes.content:
[h2][b]Get ready, Chieftains—[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The secrets hidden within the Mask are about to unfold. In 2025, you will finally uncover the ultimate truth behind the Mask and the mysterious civilization.[b] Step by step, the Mask will guide you down the Path of Evolution, lifting the veil on the mysteries behind it all.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/da9c52a5973995534cdb72943ca67c3ac19a83b9.png"][/img][/p][p]On this journey, the Mask will gradually empower you to become a true chieftain and build your very own “Mask Civilization.” [/p][p]The vision for Soulmask 1.0 is to evolve into a one-of-a-kind survival-management sandbox. This magical creation will reveal a whole new world to you through three aspects:[/p][p][b]The Mask: [/b]This mysterious artifact from an unknown civilization is more than just a vessel for your soul—it holds unimaginable power. As you delve deeper into the world, the Mask will unveil even more incredible abilities… and may even awaken an ancient consciousness that has slumbered for eons. [/p][p][/p][p][b]The Tribe:[/b] With the Mask’s help, your ability to manage and grow your tribe will become stronger than ever. The automation technologies from the Mask can also extend your clan’s influence far and wide. But don’t forget your ultimate goal—to build a civilization of your own! [/p][p][/p][p][b]Civilization: [/b]The Mask’s influence stretches far beyond a single ancient culture. In the future, you’ll uncover multiple ruins from distant past civilizations, even civilizations shaped by completely different cultures…[/p][previewyoutube="SgC8UzFBpcg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][i]*New DLC teaser from INDIE Live Premiere[/i]

Of course, the 1.0 version of Soulmask will include much more—including features you’ve been waiting for. [b]We’ll release developer insights across multiple modules to provide in-depth, one-on-one explanations so you can explore our most important version from every angle.[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png"][/img]The Mask’s evolution never stops. Soon, you’ll experience the first of many transformations: In Q2 2025, [b]we will be dropping a major update and a free DLC.[/b]

[b]Free DLC – The Mysteries of the Ancient Oriental:[/b] Chieftains are sensing a mysterious power stirring from beneath the sea. What long-forgotten force is calling to you from the ruins buried in sand and seawater for thousands of years?
[b]Major Update – Automated Clan: [/b]Tired of building every structure brick by brick? Frustrated with moving the endless resources across camps? This brand-new function, unearthed by the Mask, might just be the answer you’ve been looking for—solving these problems at the root.

These exciting new features are coming soon—and they’re only the beginning of even more changes to come in Soulmask!

What part of the roadmap are you most excited about? Let us know in the comments—we’ll respond to as many of your questions as possible![/p]

notes.title: Developer Update: What Are We Working On Now?
notes.content:
[b][h2]Greetings, Chieftains![/h2][/b]

Maggie Again! As stated in yesterday's update announcement, today we'll talk about the future of Soulmask. But first, I want to explain the purpose of this dev update: Through continuously monitoring player communities, we've observed that Soulmask has been persistently troubled by player-raised issues since the Early Access (EA) phase. Unfortunately, these aren't problems that can be solved short-term. Consequently, some community members have expressed a troubling speculation:

[i][b]Is Soulmask really not going to change anymore?[/b][/i]

This impromptu Developer Update was added specifically to give you full transparency on what our team is dedicating ourselves to during this 'intensive development phase' — particularly the systematic overhaul targeting Soulmask's most long-standing pain points.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h3][b]About Tribesmen AI[/b][/h3]

As a cornerstone of Soulmask's gameplay, tribesmen AI has unfortunately become a recurring pain point in player critiques:

[i][b]I love the game but there's serious issues. Your followers get stuck on any tree on the ground. The path finding is pathetic.[/b][/i]

[i][b]The ai of your followers you attract just plain sucks, they constantly get stuck on anything that is collide-able and dont seem to do their tasks at all because of this.[/b][/i]

We fundamentally believe that sophisticated tribesmen behavior systems are the bedrock of Soulmask  — this is why enhancing tribesmen AI remains our Tier1 development commitment.

Our goals are straightforward:
[b][list]
[*] Preserve the authentic tribal management experience while making Tribesmen's behaviors more logically consistent and dynamically alive
[*] Ensure flawless coordination where every tribe member seamlessly fulfills their designated responsibilities
[/list][/b]

You might have noticed our recent attempts to fix pathfinding in minor updates, but we're working on bigger changes — A new tribesmen system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/ad358a9701a5caf767caae52d71d71253d3f516f.gif[/img]
After that, the tribesmen will be more specialized, and they'll have a whole new path of growth while all their work will be smoother. At the same time we're having them make them more lively - in addition to more movement and behavior, there will be more initiative to do more basic things without having to have the Chieftains do everything himself.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/94b6a1152896d5e60432e78eda1bc41dca63b449.gif[/img]
[i][b]Their...ahem...fertilizer production efficiency is already legendary.[/b][/i]

This is part of our ongoing trilogy of core system revamps. Expect a dedicated deep-dive article within the next development cycle.
Yet Tribesmen evolution is merely the beginning. Simultaneously, we're developing a Modular Dynamics System to revolutionize base construction and industrial automation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h3][b]About Tribe Management[/b][/h3]

This addresses a critical pain point: We consistently observe the following issues in community feedback:

[i][b]You could set up a production chain using the members of the tribe. But it will always require a lot of micromanaging.

No "produce until X pieces are in stock". No "if you need leather to create X, have none available, but it can be made, add task at workshop"[/b][/i]

After extensive deliberation, we're developing [b]a brand new system [/b]to balance authentic production chains with player experience:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/2ea4b23340be408fc6992e4212d4b4598235fa0d.png[/img]
This gameplay module will transform you into a true manager overseeing:
[b][list]
[*] Resource allocation and personnel management
[*] Potential logistics route planning across the open world
[/list][/b]

While the UI is still in development (and the workload is massive), this will become a cornerstone of Soulmask's future. We're working overtime to bring this new feature to you ASAP!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h3][b]About Guidance & Objectives[/b][/h3]

Criticism about "guidance" and "sense of purpose" has existed since EA launch:

[b][i]
No story. There are pieces of general lore, but there is no larger plot knitting the game together. It’s just "go there kill that, make better armor, kill some more"

The game rarely tells you the reasons behind happenings. Some information are not given, or lost in translation, so you have to look around, pressing buttons, to see what they do.[/i][/b]

This has actually been on our to-do list, but all along we've been pondering a question:

[b]How exactly should we blend guidance and goals in Soulmask?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/17cd559fb2c2c07e621a11c954c89e4203a5b419.gif[/img]

Our solution lies in the game's core — the Soulmask itself. In upcoming updates, the Mask will undergo transformative changes, guiding players from survival to civilization rebuilding through expanded progression systems.

We're also enhancing progression systems — why limit growth to individuals? Stay tuned for how this integrates with the new management gameplay!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h3][b]It's that ALL?[/b][/h3]

Alright, after writing all this, you might still have complaints:

[i][b] "This is too vague!"[/b][/i]

But truthfully, many of these features are still in early development, so we can only provide a general framework now. [i][b]We aim to reveal concrete details by April.[/b][/i]

We're working tirelessly to ensure this official reveal won't disappoint any of you.

Of course, if you're thinking:

[i][b]"I have countless questions and can't wait until April!"[/b][/i]

We'll soon have an opportunity: This month on Reddit's Soulmask board, me (Maggie) and producer ZIMA will answer all your questions - controller support?, equipment durability, multiplayer issues? Ask us ANYTHING!

We'll announce the exact timing soon. See you then!

notes.title: Soulmask "Mad Hula" Update & New Historical Low!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hey, Chieftains![/b][/h2]

Maggie here! Let’s cut to the chase: our [b]Brand-new dessert-sized Update is dropping alongside Steam’s Spring Sale, hitting the shelves at the lowest price ever. Spread the word to your crew[/b]—this deal’s too good to miss!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2646460/Soulmask/

Maybe our recent silence has left you a little restless. Don’t worry, we’ve been cooking something up behind the scenes. We might spill the beans tomorrow in a proper sit-down, but today? Nah—today’s all about kicking back and dancing with your tribe!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
In this "Mad Hula" update, we’re rolling out our first-ever animated skin: the Hula Skirt! This vibrant, multi-colored skirt spawns randomly on the Barbarian Tribe’s folks. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/ac9dd3b09412051c1e1fd372006c6fe5bed97902.png[/img]

Recruit them or take them down—either way, you’ll snag the blueprint for this beauty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/efcf311b2906a0a32ed763c910cdf1f677b409e3.jpg[/img]

Slip into the “Hula Skirt,” and you and your tribespeople unlock a fresh hula dance. Feel like throwing a massive hula party at your base? Go wild—we won’t stop you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/407b73625706cd1426638cdc42bdf85ae01080a2.gif[/img]

That’s it? Yep, this bite-sized update is just that sweet and simple. I can already see your disappointed faces through the screen—hold tight, though! [b]Tomorrow, we’re diving into the big stuff:[/b] [i][b]the “Ultimate Update” for Soulmask[/b][/i]. It’s what we’ve been pouring our hearts into, and we can’t wait to share.

Catch you tomorrow, Chieftains! For now, let’s revel in the spring vibes with a Hula Skirt bash!！

notes.content:
Dear Chieftains,

Happy New Year! To provide a better gaming experience, the server will undergo maintenance. It will be temporarily unavailable starting from March 13, at 7:00 AM UTC, with an expected downtime 30 minutes. This update includes a client update, and chieftains will need to update their client to enjoy the game normally. We are very grateful for your understanding and support.

Added game save function to single player mode

Added a new skin - Hula Skirt
a) Skin Quantity: 3 sets for male, 3 sets for female
b) Release Locations: Small-scale ancient ruins in the Western Rainforest and Northern Rainforest
c) Acquisition Method: Defeat barbarians wearing Hula Skirts to obtain the Hula Skirt Blueprint and unlock

Added new character gestures and dances

Great Sword Mastery - Counter Lifesteal skill effect changed to: When attacked, counterattacks automatically and gains a 30% lifesteal (this lifesteal will increase to 60% if the target is NPC); when attacking with a great sword, converts 10% of damage dealt into healing.

Hammer Mastery - Lament of Earth-splitting skill effect changed to: The hammer's normal skill will inflict additional earth-splitting damage, knocking the target down.

Dual-blade Mastery - Spectral Blade skill effect changed to: Gains additional Crit rate during the period, doubles the Bleed Points for all skills, and inflicts double bleed effect. Dealing damage using Dual-blade also gains a 1% DMG Immunity with "Spectral Protection", stacking up to 20 times. The status ends concurrently with the Spectral Blade buff.

Shield Mastery - Get Poised Before Strike skill effect changed to: Gains a 30s buff effect: Upon each successful defense with a shield, recovers 10% of Max Stamina and boosts own ATK by (0.5%*Max HP+5), stacking up to 5 times for 50s. Dealing damage clears all effects and converts 30% of the damage done to healing.

Spear Mastery - Spear Flurry skill effect changed to: Executes a rapid succession of spear strikes, suffocating the enemy with unyielding ferocity. The damage dealt ignores 50% Shield DEF and 80% DEF of other weapons.

Bow Mastery - Divine Power Possession skill effect changed to: After activation, gain divine power temporarily: With a Bow or Rapid Bow, fire 3 arrows at once with a 10% chance to Slow the target by 80% for 3 seconds. With a Great Bow, fire piercing arrows with a 25% chance to deal a small amount of extra damage and inflict Coma. With a Longbow, deal damage that ignores shield defense and gain a 25% chance to drain 100 Stamina from the target.

[b]The following blade mastery effects have been changed:[/b]

Vaulting Whirlwind: Makes a forward dash and slashes the enemy, dealing damage twice and inflicting "Slash Wound": when using Sprint during this period, speed will be reduced by 80% for 5 seconds.

Turn Slash: Gathers strength in the right arm to deliver a fatal blow, dealing a great amount of damage. Additionally, When used by a player, the target becomes unable to lock onto enemies for 5 seconds. After the skill ends, the player cannot be targeted for 5 seconds.

Dash Slash: Dash toward the enemies and slashes, dealing one-time damage and reducing their ATK by 10% (half effect on bosses), up to 3 stacks.

Upstroke Slash: Lifts the target into the air before releasing the skill again for an aerial follow-up attack. When used by a player, the first hit deals damage and inflicts the "aerial disarm" status on the target. While airborne, the target will be forced to sheath their weapon.

Rolling Slashes: Dashes forward and flips, slashing at the enemy to deal damage twice, with a chance for the second hit to cause a knockdown. When used by a player, the attack deals damage and temporarily nullifies the target's damage reduction effects for 5 seconds.

[b]The following gauntlet mastery effects have been changed:[/b]

Revolving Kick: Consumes a lot of enemy Stamina and makes them exit the defense status. When used by a player, the attack deals damage and drains 30 stamina from the target. (Range and cooldown increase)

Whirlstep Uppercut: Dodges sideways and dashes forward to launch a hooking punch counterattack. When used by a player, hitting the target inflicts a 5-second effect: lose 20 Stamina upon each attack received.

2-Strike Kick: Performs consecutive sweeping kicks to the enemy's lower limbs, restricting their movement. Each kick reduces the target's movement speed for 10 seconds, up to 2 stacks. When used by a player, hitting the target inflicts "Exhausted" effect: each Roll greatly drains the user's energy, deducting 50 Stamina and lowering Attack Speed by 50% for 5 seconds.

Charged Punch: After charging up for an extended period of time, punches forward, dealing a great amount of damage and easily breaking through the opponent's defense. When used by a player, hitting the target inflicts "Fatigued" effect: each time dealing damage loses an additional 30 Stamina.

Counter Punch: Takes a defensive stance that greatly reduces the DMG taken. If attacked at this time, strikes back with a powerful blow, knocking the attacker back; if the strike comes from a player, it will "Disarm" the target hit.

Backstab: Quickly charges to the back of the target, executing from behind. This skill grants invincibility but cannot be used on other players, and cannot be used on the same target twice within a certain period of time. Gains a stack of 20% damage reduction whenever taking damage, stacking up to 5 times. At 5 stacks, all stacks are removed when the effect activates, triggering a 10-second cooldown. (Switching weapons clears all stacks).

Fixed an issue where the Spear Mastery skill "Ultimate Throw" would sometimes prevent the player from throwing spears again if the thrown spear wasn't retrieved.

Fixed an issue where the damage numbers would be displayed incorrectly when the "[PEN DEF]" attribute was activated.

Corrected chest placement in the Giant Crater Holy Ruins.

Power extension shaft items are now stackable.

The powered refining furnace can now produce plaster and coking coal.

All blueprints craftable on a loom can now also be crafted on a powered spinning wheel.

notes.title: Soulmask Server Merge FAQ
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hey Chieftains![/b][/h2]

We’ve compiled every detail about the server merge here to ensure clarity. This guide includes:

[list]
[*] [b]Full server merge timelines (with precise UTC conversions)
[*] Answers to all anticipated questions
[*] Support channels[/b]
[/list]
Let’s dive straight in!

[h3][b]Which servers will be merged?[/b][/h3]

The PVE servers from the following regions:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/2c63d5d7457938cd080a03bfcf3de853e8c3a272.png[/img]

[h3][b]Server Merge Timeline[/b][/h3]

All times are listed in UTC

[h3][b]Australia (AU) Server[/b][/h3]

[b]Merge Start:[/b]
UTC 02/28 07:30 – Old servers reboot (~5 mins downtime).
UTC 02/28 08:00 – Merge servers open for transfers.

[b]Merge End:[/b]
UTC 03/13 07:00 – Old & Merge servers close for automated transfers.
UTC 03/13 10:00 – Merge servers reopen; old servers close.

[h3][b]South America (SA) Server[/b][/h3]

[b]Merge Start:[/b]
UTC 02/28 22:30 – Old servers reboot (~5 mins downtime).
UTC 02/28 23:00 – Merge servers open.
[b]Merge End:[/b]
UTC 03/13 07:00 – Old & Merge servers close for automated transfers.
UTC 03/13 10:00 – Merge servers reopen; old servers close.

[h3][b]Asia (AS) Server[/b][/h3]

[b]Merge Start:[/b]
UTC 03/07 11:30 – Old servers reboot (~5 mins downtime).
UTC 03/07 12:00 – Merge servers open.
[b]Merge End:[/b]
UTC 03/20 07:00 – Servers close for automated transfers.
UTC 03/20 10:00 – Merge servers reopen.

[h3][b]North America (NA) Servers[/b][/h3]

[b]Merge Start:[/b]
UTC 03/07 23:30 – Old servers reboot (~5 mins downtime).
UTC 03/08 00:00 – Merge servers open.
[b]Merge End:[/b]
UTC 03/20 07:00 – Servers close for automated transfers.
UTC 03/20 10:00 – Merge servers reopen.

[h3][b]Europe (EU) Servers[/b][/h3]

Merge Start:
UTC 03/07 18:30 – Old servers reboot (~5 mins downtime).
UTC 03/07 19:00 – Merge servers open.
Merge End:
UTC 03/20 07:00 – Servers close for automated transfers.
UTC 03/20 10 – Merge servers reopen.

[h3][b]Recommended Transfer Process[/b][/h3]

In short: [b]Gather your tribesmen and resources, then journey through the Mysterious Portal to rebuild![/b]
While optional, this sequence ensures smooth migration:

[olist]
[*] Prepare a small "starter kit" (foundation materials, storage, campfire).
[*] Dismantle your main base (yes, including elephant platforms!), consolidating all resources into storage. Keep a campfire and Mysterious Portal active.
[*] Send one controlled tribesman + one companion with fully loaded mounts to the nearest Mysterious Portal. Interact (long-press) → Select Cross-server List → Choose Merge server.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/a6492aca45421cc731ee59f5ec6ff694ceddd93f.png[/img]

[*] Settle in the new world, then return for remaining tribesmen/resources.
[*] Initial character transfer: Due to technical limits, your main character must resurrect in the new server. Use a captured NPC or Info Entry tribesman for this.
[/olist]
[h3][b]FAQ[/b][/h3]

[b]1.Can I create new characters in Merge servers during the merge?[/b]

No. New characters are disabled until the merge completes. Existing characters transfer normally.

[b]2.Why can’t I transfer my main character via the Mysterious Portal?[/b]

Technical limitations require a one-time resurrection in the new server.

[b]3.Will my spawn location stay the same post-merge?[/b]

Yes! Coordinates remain identical across Mysterious Portals.

[b]4.What if I lose data?[/b]

Report immediately in our [url=https://discord.com/channels/1160486185840418927/1343555669252509708][b]support Discord channel.[/b][/url]

[b]5.Are mounts restricted during transfer?[/b]

All mounts transferable except:
[list]
[*] Platform saddle-equipped elephants
[*] Mounts carrying tribesman
[*] Remove attached structures/passengers before transfer.
[/list]
[b]6. Inactive player data handling?[/b]

We'll automatically transfer:
[list]
[*] Character name & Consciousness Level
[*] Tech Points & Mask Collection
[*] Map Progress & Info Entry 
[/list]
[b]Note: Tribesmen unsaved/structures will be permanently lost.[/b]

[b]7. main character is stranded after transferring others—help![/b]

It's basically the same as above - your physical body disappears with the old world at the same time as the server shuts down. However, you can still get your initial character back to the new world by dying once - resurrecting.

[b]8.Any bonuses during the merge?[/b]

During the Merge time, the servers offer 3x XP, loot drops, and round-the-clock world events during transfers!

[b]9.How are tribes affected?[/b]

Affiliated tribes auto-form during transfers. Post-merge, they become main tribes seamlessly.

[b]10.Can I recruit new members mid-merge?[/b]

Not until the merge completes. Alternatively, disband your tribe in old server and recreate a new one in merge server.

[b]Still stuck?[/b] Join our dedicated [url=https://discord.com/channels/1160486185840418927/1343555669252509708][b]Discord Channel[/b][/url]. [b]Admins are on STANDBY![/b]

[b]See you in the new world, Chieftains![/b]

notes.title: Soulmask Official Server Merge Announcement
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Chieftains![/h2]

We hope you're continuing to enjoy your adventures in Soulmask! Currently, our team is fully focused on finalizing the upcoming 1.0 release - you can expect exciting new content very soon!

However, we recognize the importance of addressing current priorities first.

Hence, the announcement:

[h3][b] A new batch of PVE servers will be released and some of the oldest PVE servers will be merged.[/b][/h3]

We deeply regret having to deliver this news — we know this announcement brings countless questions and frustrations. Please allow Community Manager Maggie just a few moments to walk you through the details:

[h3][b]Why is this necessary?[/b][/h3]

Why are we making these changes? Let's journey back to those first exhilarating 30 days post-launch last year. Your overwhelming passion transformed every official server into what felt like an overstuffed capybara enclosure - our veteran chieftains will remember the chaos of five players wrestling over a single scout spawn!

Now that a few months have passed, perhaps our private servers have seen significant improvements, or perhaps Soulmask’s mods offer a different kind of appeal. According to our data, a considerable number of players from older main servers have migrated to the private servers. As for those who remain... Maggie is very impressed with the incredible wonders you’ve built on the main servers - like this one:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/9cc0e28f705e8b2cc66185462d4387185b3de9f3.png[/img]

[i]Trust me[/i], apart from your tribe members and moose NPCs passing by in the wilderness, there are almost no living players left in these servers to appreciate your masterpieces. In fact, this is just one aspect of the current state of PVE servers. This doesn't match the atmosphere developers envisioned for Soulmask's official PVE servers: a bustling world where chieftains explore and reshape things together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/74c8e15ee5e8f840882101333c7d98c25a399e29.gif[/img]
[i]*Epic build, but looks like I'm the only one around to appreciate them lol[/i]

 Therefore, through this server consolidation, we sincerely aim to help every player who still cherishes the official servers recapture that golden era we shared. Of course, Maggie can already anticipate your concerns: 

[i][b]"What does this mean? Am I forced to start fresh in a new environment?"[/b][/i]

But we assure you: When migrating your tribespeople and possessions to this renewed world, you might discover completely new allies - this social alchemy is precisely what makes Soulmask's official servers uniquely compelling.

Also, we don’t intend for everyone to start completely over. 

[b]Before the official server merger, there will be a 2-week transfer period where you can move everything—from your constructions and resources to your tribesmen—through the mysterious portal to the new server.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/4c4c026806a06d2b4eb48f8716fffc68f39f7dca.jpg[/img]

[b]And this isn't a one-time thing![/b] You can transfer [i]multiple times[/i] until all your assets are moved to the new world. So yes, you won’t need to collect a ton of wood and copper ores all over again.

Also, during these 2 weeks, we will [b]maintain a higher collection multiplier[/b] on the new servers. There's no better time than now to expand your base!

Of course, for chieftains who might have missed this announcement, we will transfer all progress from your last logged-in characters to the new servers.

[h3][b]Which servers will be merged?[/b][/h3]

We expect to close a portion of the old servers in each region, and at the same time, we'll be opening up a bunch of new merge servers to give you all access to a whole new world:
[list]
[*] [b]Asia:[/b] AS[1001] to AS[1080] will be closed and merged into the new PvE_20 Person Tribe server AS[01] to [08].
[*] [b]North America:[/b] NA[2001] to NA[2048] will be closed and merged into a new PvE_20 Person Tribe server NA[01] to [03].
[*] [b]Europe:[/b] EU[3001] to EU[3063] will be closed and merged into a new PvE_20 Person Tribe server EU[01] to [09].
[*] [b]Oceania:[/b] OA[4001] to OA[4006] will be closed and merged into a new PvE_20 Person Tribe server OA[01].
[*] [b]South America:[/b] SA[5001] to SA[5008] will be closed and merged into the new PvE_20 Person Tribe server SA[01].
[/list]

You can see more specific server correspondences in the table below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/2c63d5d7457938cd080a03bfcf3de853e8c3a272.png[/img]

[h3][b]Is there a specific timeline?[/b][/h3]

The following is our estimated server merge schedule.  we will provide further details in FAQ:

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2646460/view/501691675000703569?l=english

February 28 (Friday): New servers in the Australia/South America regions will open and the 2-week transfer period will begin.
March 7 (Friday): New servers in the Asia/Europe/North America regions will open and the 2-week transfer period will begin.
March 13 (Thursday): End of the transfer period for Australia/South America's old servers; all data on the old servers will be wiped.
March 20 (Thursday): End of the transfer period for Asia/Europe/North America old servers; all data on the old servers will be wiped.

[h3][b]How will this work exactly?[/b][/h3]

We are currently making the final adjustments for this major change. Please trust that once it's completed, we'll share all the details with you. But for now, Maggie will give you a general overview of the process: We will be launching a new batch of servers, which will only allow players from the merging old servers to enter via themysterious portal (at that time, the mysterious portal will offer a new interaction option). Typically, several old servers will be merged to a single new server.

This will last for two weeks. During this period, you can transfer resources, mounts, and tribesmen (only one tribesman per transfer) to the new server through the mysterious portal, [b]but the elephants equipped with a deck saddle will not be able to pass through the mysterious portal.[/b]

During the two-week server transfer period, there will be a new cross-server option in the mysterious portal of all the merging servers. Once you transfer through it, you will appear at the corresponding location on the new server.
If you don’t log into your Soulmask character on the main server within these two weeks, don’t worry! We’ll transfer the progress of the last character you logged out from directly to the new world. Your character name, awareness strength, technology points, collected masks and mask levels, map progress, and the tribesmen information registered in the mask altar will all be preserved.

[h3][b]I have more questions![/b][/h3]

Yes, we hear you! We already released a more detailed FAQ that covers all the details, rules, and everything you need to know.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2646460/view/501691675000703569?l=english

[h3][b]I can’t wait until next week, I need to know the answers NOW.[/b][/h3]

We’ve set up a dedicated server merge Discord channel where you can ask any questions (or just vent and rant at Maggie). [url=https://discord.com/channels/1160486185840418927/1343555669252509708][b]Click here to join[/b][/url].

[h3][b]What’s next?[/b][/h3]

We fully acknowledge the irreversible impact this server reduction will have on our Soulmask community. Let this be our solemn assurance: [b]This marks the sole instance of server reduction during Early Access[/b].As for how things will change after the official release, it's hard to predict now but rest assured, your gaming experience will always be our top priority.

[b]Community Manager
Maggie[/b]
