notes.title: Soulmask FAST Q＆A 09
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hi, Chieftains:[/b][/h2]

Happy New Year! It's been a while since the last Soulmask FAQ, but with the release of the "Wild Dash" update, many new Chiefs have reached out with fresh questions—of course, if you want to review some of the topics we've covered before, you can check out our previous FAQ here:

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2646460/view/4585314779419756894

Once again, we've invited ZIMA, the producer of Soulmask, to address some of the most common feedback we've been seeing in the community and comments. Most of these issues will be addressed in future game updates. Without further ado, let’s dive into the main topics!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h3][b]1. My Soulmask keeps crashing. What should I do?[/b][/h3]

First, we sincerely apologize for the crashes you've been experiencing. We've received a lot of feedback about frequent crashes recently. We've identified a few possible causes to help you quickly troubleshoot the issue.

[b]① Game package download errors or disk storage issues causing data reading errors and crashes[/b]

[b]Solution:[/b]
[list]
[*] Verify the integrity of the game files on Steam.
[*] Optimize and defragment your disk, and if possible, store the game on a solid-state drive (SSD).
[/list]

[b]② Insufficient computer memory (less than 16GB) or disabled virtual memory on your computer, causing the game to crash due to memory exhaustion.[/b]

[b]Solution:

[/b]Close unnecessary programs while gaming, and enable or increase the virtual memory on your PC.

[b]③ Graphics card failure or device error causing the game to crash.

Solution:[/b]
[list]
[*] Ensure your graphics card drivers are up to date.
[*] For cards with less than 4GB of VRAM, reduce the resolution or graphics settings.
[*] Try switching to DirectX11 or DirectX12 to launch the game.
[*] If none of the above works, try launching the game in SafeMode.
[/list]
[h3][b]2. The glider is fun, but there's a downside: it has a slight magnetic attraction to the ground, making it hard to take off unless the slope is steeper than 90 degrees[/b][/h3]

[b][i]Improve ASAP! [/i][/b]We've noticed that the glider doesn't work properly on lower-angle slopes, which is partly related to the character's weight. We're working on an optimization to ensure it works smoothly.

[h3][b]3. Although I know Soulmask only supports certain controllers, it's still quite difficult to navigate the crafting interface![/b][/h3]

Designing controller support has always been a challenge, especially with the UI overhaul. We'll make it a top priority of our long-term optimization plan for "Soulmask" to improve the controller experience.

Chieftains, feel free to share the most frustrating controller issues you encounter in the comments so we can prioritize their optimization.

[h3][b]4. There are still too few buildings available. Can we expect more to be added?[/b][/h3]

Of course! More building components and a wider range of decorations are certainly on our to-do list!

Additionally, we're focusing on improving the convenience of the building process. We plan to introduce features like building blueprints and quick construction, along with further optimization of alignment logic for building components. Of course, it will take some time, but we believe it won't be long before you see these improvements!

If you would like to suggest building ideas from you to Soulmask, you can post [url=https://wj.mobijoygames.com/p/TVBs7mem][b]here[/b][/url]!

[h3][b]5. The tutorial in Soulmask seems complicated, and a lot of things aren't explained, making it really tough for new players![/b][/h3]

With the release of the "Wild Dash" update and the influx of new players, the issue of player guidance has been raised once again. Let's talk about how we plan to overhaul the guidance system in future updates.

In the new version, we plan to introduce a new NPC — [b]the residual consciousness of the initial Soulmask.[/b] This NPC will engage in more interactive dialogues with the Chieftains, providing a more natural way for new players to immerse themselves in the world.

For more complex systems, and everything related to Soulmask shards, we plan to integrate the wiki content directly into the game, creating an accessible in-game knowledge base for players. If you're unsure how to obtain a certain material, you'll be able to find the answer directly within the game, without needing to switch to your browser for a search.

[h3][b]6. When the player character is resurrected, followers will automatically cancel their deployment status, unless you risk your life to approach and redeploy them. Otherwise, they will die in battle![/b][/h3]

[h3][b]7. Followers are too easily killed by traps. Can we improve their situation?[/b][/h3]

[i][b]Improve ASAP! [/b][/i]We've decided to tackle both of these issues together. As you know, Soulmask has always made tribesmen our key feature, which naturally includes the followers as a part of our combat system. Therefore, improving their AI behavior and enhancing player control will be one of our major focuses in future updates.

This includes a better tribesmen control system and enhanced AI behavior: from issuing commands, idle animations, and following modes, to reacting autonomously in various dangerous situations. This also includes how followers react after the player's death.

As for dealing with traps, we will address this within the week! For now, we'll resolve this issue with the following two methods:

[list]
[*] [b]Reduce trap damage to non-player characters
[*] Increase the followers' ability to avoid traps, especially when in various states, they will develop an awareness to evade them.[/b]
[/list]
Though we've mentioned this several times, our ultimate goal for followers remains the same: to be the best assistants for Chieftains in any battle. We will keep working towards this goal.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
I know there are countless questions not covered above, but don't worry, we have the comments section for that: feel free to leave any questions you want answered, and we'll address them in the next Q&A!

Enjoy the game, and see you in the next issue!

Throughout November, we were hard at work on our biggest update of the year:[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2646460/view/4443459004907126789]Wild Ride[/url]。We're thrilled that so many of you love what we've created. Our 30-day positive rating has reached an impressive 84%—a huge thanks to every player who's supported our work!

This update also sparked a new wave of screenshot boom in our community, and Maggie makes it a point to enjoy the bizarre and wonderful scenes created by players in the new version every day:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/f371b298dbdd9db7f8d1dbccb02d4604f4b6fb97.jpg[/img]
[i]*From Discord user @Ryuk—— How could such a tiny creature leave behind such a massive mess...?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/c735a39210fc861399bdbc21498d3d801c0e902b.jpg[/img]
[i]From Discord user @Uldi—— Check on the living conditions of those farmed bison...[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/c6fbf4136db17e9b1ba6cb0453590f4d8e0e7caa.jpg[/img]
[i]From Discord user @Xamand—— Who says we still need to manually transport new barbarians?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/33e9f5e29b3fdd8219020ada5a8c7816532bb79f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/ecc5a47affd5c9c60a1274eb6e0b6f375ef84bb1.jpg[/img]
[i]From Player @澤井Shiho—— With some creative building and the right mods, you can experience a completely unique version of Soulmask...[/i]

Thanks to these players for sharing! You've shown us just how much more vibrant the world of Soulmask can be.

Enough reminiscing about the past—let's talk about the present. To wrap up the year, we've prepared a small gift for everyone:[b] A special festive edition of Soulmask![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h3][b]Winter Wish Update! [/b][/h3]

Even barbarians have their own rituals at the end of the year. Let me introduce you to our new building: the [b]Festive Decoration Tree![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/bb7e1fc503c1f94212ad03159bc078305e9389e1.png[/img]

This magical fir tree is unlocked for free in the tech tree. It not only adds a cozy charm to your camp but also periodically grants you mysterious holiday gifts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/1102cb5eb65746ea6d4f0592892bf3bd2ace1ce6.png[/img]

The gift boxes may contain sorts of furniture recipes: festive dining tables, roasted turkeys, and other lavish holiday feasts for your tribe to enjoy this winter. But remember, folks! [b][i]These are just props![/i][/b] You still need to keep your tribe fed! So make sure to stock up on "Turkey Platters" in your warehouse!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/ede587c6eac715b98ad55f76d695cd77cfc2404b.png[/img]

We've also added new red-themed sleigh and moose saddle skins. And don't miss the signature "toy" of the snowy mountains: snowballs! You could play as a certain holiday figure, riding a moose and pelting every target in sight with snowballs...


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/1e74f8938a09a090c47f49259cf19497077d6692.png[/img]

Of course, beyond these updates and events, our focus is shifting to future development. While we can't share too many details just yet, we're excited to give you a glimpse of what's in store for 2025.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h3][b]Soulmask in 2025[/b][/h3]

If we were to summarize our plans for Soulmask in 2025, our initial roadmap would include three key priorities:

[b]Feedback from Our Chieftains[/b]

In 2025, our top priority remains the same: continuing to respond to feedback from players who love Soulmask. We are more than happy to work alongside you to make this game even better!

Of course, as the Chieftain community continues to grow, the feedback we receive is becoming increasingly diverse. In response, [b]we are exploring the addition of new game modes to better cater to the varied gameplay needs of different types of players.[/b]

Naturally, beyond working with all of you to refine the game, we also have our own long-term plans.

[b]The Story Behind Soulmask[/b]

We believe that the exploration of civilization, consciousness, and soul remains an integral part of Soulmask. In 2025, we will place even more emphasis on this aspect, [b]from the story to the new world, with more content than you can imagine waiting for you to explore.[/b]

According to the established game world lore, a brand-new continent, new civilizations with their own unique Soulmasks, and entirely new gameplay that is vastly different from what we have now are already on our to-do list. All of this will be unveiled in 2025!

[b]Tribes! Tribesmen![/b]

Tribes and tribesmen will always be the most important part of Soulmask. Moving forward, we will continue to focus on optimizing and enhancing all content related to tribe management and tribesmen. We believe in focusing on what matters most and doing it well, and we fully understand this principle.

The automation of resource acquisition and production,[b] tribe defenses, tribesmen AI, and enhancing the tribe atmosphere are all being actively worked on.[/b]

We apologize that we don’t have further details to share at the moment, but I am confident that we won’t make you wait for too long! In 2025, Soulmask will be even more distinct, so stay tuned!

Lastly, we wish everyone a joyful holiday season and happy gaming! We’ll see you again soon!

notes.title: Soulmask Early Access Regular Update 31
notes.content:
Dear Chieftains,

To provide a better gaming experience, the server will undergo maintenance. It will be temporarily unavailable starting from December 19, at 7:00 AM UTC, this maintenance will involve data migration, with an expected downtime of 180 minutes. The Oceania and South America servers are expected to have a downtime of 30 minutes. This update includes a client update, and chieftains will need to update their client to enjoy the game normally. We are very grateful for your understanding and support.

The update details are as follows:

[h3]【Adjustments and Bug Fixes】[/h3]

[b]Winter Holiday Update Content[/b]
Instant Unlock: Christmas Tree, special mask appearance - Red Hat
The Christmas tree regularly offers gifts that unlock assembly units: Holiday Table, assorted Decorative Food (Grains, Meat, Fruits & Vegetables, Beverages, Roasted Turkey), Sled Skin - Red Dream, Turkey Meal, Holiday Decorative Deer.
The Christmas tree also regularly offers gifts that unlock tools like the Red Moose Saddles and Snowballs.
During the holiday season, turkey production is increased (for making roasted turkeys and turkey meals)
Added a mount switch to confirm whether damage received by the mount while riding transfers to the rider (applicable to MOD).
Added customization parameters for all server events, effective only when the server event adjustment is enabled.
Added a new throwable item—snowball that transforms the hit target into a snowman.
Thatch Pillars can be built underwater.
Server lists now support name search.
Original characters keep their mastery settings before being copied.
The message "Must be uncrafted on a mysterious stone table" will appear for certain items like Archaic Gear, Mysterious Gear, and Red Crystals when placed on a normal Uncrafting Table.
Increased Red Crystal production with a higher chance to produce Mysterious Gear for Shadow King - Shadowblade.
Power Workshop no longer produces Wooden Strips, Hardwood Strips, and Hardwood Parts; they are now produced by Powered Cutting Machine.

[h3][Bug Fixes and Optimizations][/h3]

Fixed the issue of targets killed by ignition possibly having no affiliations.
Fixed the issue where the interrupted bow mastery skill "Eclipse" carries over effects to the next attack after rolling.
Fixed the issue caused by switching the construction hammer in Quality Assessment.
Optimized the standby interruption issue.
Optimized focus stability during prompt changes.
Optimized the overhead dialogue display for NPCs to reduce lag.
Fixed the texture mapping issue with the Bronze Throwing Knife, Throwing Axe, and Lance.
Fixed the issue of the chest disappearing when moved from the Giant Elephant Deck Saddle to the ground.
Fixed the stucking issue when switching the construction hammer in Quality Assessment.
Fixed the issue of the modification icon not disappearing properly after repairing gear.
Fixed the issue of tribesmen being unable to auto-manage the Leather (Trim) crafting queues, etc.
Fixed the focusing issue of error prompts in Settings.

notes.title: Soulmask Mod Highlight #2 - December
notes.content:
[h2]Hi Chieftains![/h2]

Another month has flown by, and Maggie hope you’re still keeping up with our Workshop updates! Over the last two months, our amazing Modders have been getting comfortable with our tools and are now starting to showcase their incredible creations.

It's time to give these incredible mods the attention they deserve and ensure you don't miss out on the amazing work the community has been doing. Let's shine a spotlight on these fantastic creations once again!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h3][b]1. Tasty HUD By Noms[/b][/h3]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3371143686&searchtext=

From one of our most brilliant Modders, Noms, comes the Tasty series, which lets you take full control over the main HUD in Soulmask. Resize it, move it wherever you want, or even hide it entirely—it’s all up to you. Now’s your chance to customize Soulmask to suit your style!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/996eed62b2a0f2a4992c59336a2b9c9f3933f171.jpg[/img]

If you haven't heard about the Tasty series yet, be sure to check out our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2646460/view/4544786458111624109][b]October Highlight[/b][/url] for all the details. It's one of the top server management mods available, and if you run a private server, it's an absolute must-have!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/5d220899ebe0cc9a849e67f5fd33d1d2cac2f3a0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h3][b]2. Collection Pack Series By squash20[/b][/h3]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3372041077&searchtext=

Looking to add a medieval touch to your builds? squash20’s Collection Pack Series brings you a beautiful set of medieval-style candles, torches, chandeliers, and candelabras.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/7e31c369c4edb204da78d8c985666d608d18d397.jpg[/img]

The lighting effects on the candles alone are absolutely stunning! If your stone castle could use a little European charm, this mod will definitely bring that unique, old-world feel to your world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/523aff11ef333b70239862ecf25e05b2e6d3583b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h3][b]3. Glass Building By Lucifer[/b][/h3]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3344831027

Ever dreamed of living in a crystal castle? Or is that just me...?

Well, if you’re anything like me, you’ve got to try this new glass building material mod! It may not be actual crystal, but it’s pretty close, right? Created by the talented Modder Lucifer, this mod includes frosted and transparent glass options. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/88a9056033dc784275c1a666eb674371a22a2693.jpg[/img]

Whether you’re looking for a sleek glass door or dreaming of a massive, transparent castle, this mod will unlock endless creative possibilities for your builds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/33b352a970101abcc0bce2b02a1b3528ff354d77.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h3][b]4. Telescope By Lucifer[/b][/h3]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3377107031

I know many of you have been eagerly awaiting this, and yes, it's exactly what you think it is:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/98f82bfbf8af2176cc65c710202d699d5fa9ffe6.jpg[/img]

I probably don't need to introduce this one much, but here it is anyway: the highly efficient tribesmen selection mod by Lucifer. With this mod, you can see literally "all" the information about the barbarians. If you've ever been "tricked" by high-rarity but low-quality tribesmen, then this is the must-have mod for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h3][b]5. Warlock Weaponry By Krysez[/b][/h3]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3368648373&searchtext=

Tired of the usual realistic combat (though it’s always fun)? Then Warlock Weaponry is here to shake things up: it introduces an entirely new magic system! Use tech points to learn magic, gather Essence to craft powerful spells, and most exciting of all—equip the Essence Gauntlet! With it, you can cast a variety of spells.

These spells allow you to poison, freeze, or slow down your enemies, and even boost your own speed. Creator Krysez has promised that this is just the beginning—expect even more magic to be added in future updates. If you’re looking to try out a completely new playstyle in Soulmask, learning magic might just be the perfect place to start.

[previewyoutube=l38h99_AXJg;full][/previewyoutube]
We hope these mods, along with the exciting Frenzied Rush update, add a touch of magic to your holidays. And, of course, if you’ve got some awesome mod ideas of your own, don't hesitate to join our Discord channel for mod creators and DM Maggie to get access to the Modkits!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]

This is Maggie, and I can’t wait to catch up with you all again soon!

notes.title: Soulmask Official Server Fair Operation Notice 2.0
notes.content:
Dear Chieftains,

       In this virtual world, we believe what we're after is joy and challenges instead of argument and fight. So we sincerely call upon all players to try their best to maintain a wholesome and friendly game environment together.

　　Any and all cheat codes, third-party tools, and other forms of cheating are not tolerated in the game. After confirmation, the cheating account will be forever banned and revealed in the community. We also encourage you to report to us via the Report interface or other windows, cleaning the game environment together.

      Soulmask values the fairness in the game and would do anything to maintain it. Our operation team will vet these illegal behaviors and take measures accordingly. Should any player be found misbehaving in official servers, we'd have to resort to Warning, Mute, and even Account Ban, all in an attempt to protect the players' interest and ensure that every player can enjoy a fair and positive game.Thanks for your support and understanding!
 
 
[h3]Behaviors that cause your game account to be banned:[/h3]

1. Any modification or testing of the game client, including but not limited to decompiling programs, packet spoofing, and damaging the game client.
2. The use of any third-party software, including but not limited to cheat codes, modifiers, scripts, and attachments.
3. Use DDOS Attack or other technical means to obtain in-game interests.
4. Exploit game bugs and procedure loopholes to gain interests, to disturb the gaming order, or to achieve personal purposes that cause loss to other players.
5.Prevent other players from building or leaving their bases (applies only to PvE servers).
 
[h3]Behaviors that cause your game account to be muted:[/h3]

1. Send words to pose officials, GMs, or administrators.
2. Post abusive, threatening, harassing, obscene, pornographic, hateful, defamatory, or otherwise offensive comments.
3. Negative comments on religion, international politics, terrorism, nationalism, racial discrimination, or other sensitive topics.
4. Post ads, external links, and other content unrelated to the game.
5. Talk about using illegal means or exploiting game loopholes to undermine fair gaming.
 
[h3]Behaviors that cause your in-game buildings to be dismantled:[/h3]

1. Use bugs to build your base inside a mountain, underwater, on the map edge, or at other places. 
2. Erect unauthorized building shapes.
3. Block public resource points such as excavation pits, barbarian camps or barracks, and portals, etc. (applies to both PvE and PvP No Raid servers).
4.Any structures that violate the above rules will be recorded and immediately dismantled upon verification, with no further notice issued. Repeated violations will result in additional penalties,  such as account bans, depending on the severity of infractions. Therefore, we kindly ask all players to adhere to the server rules and help maintain a fair and just gaming environment.

notes.title: Soulmask Early Access Regular Update 29
notes.content:
Dear Chieftains,

To provide a better gaming experience, the server will undergo maintenance. It will be temporarily unavailable starting from December 5, at 7:00 AM UTC, with an expected downtime 30 minutes. This update includes a client update, and chieftains will need to update their client to enjoy the game normally. We are very grateful for your understanding and support.

The update details are as follows:

[h3]【Adjustments and Bug Fixes】[/h3]

Added Nightstone as an upgrade option for tribesman buildings.

Reduced the impact of the Burn effect on defense and shortened its duration to 60 seconds.

Added a cap on the maximum single-hit percentage damage caused by Groundspike and Peg Board against wild enemies.

Managing beehives is now included in tribesman work lists.

Plaster can now only be crafted in a Blast Furnace that is actively fueled and burning.

The Converter now supports converting bee larvae, premium animal materials, and some semi-finished materials.

Updated some animal icons in the Domestication interface.

Private servers now support configuring region settings via command line.

Reduced the frequency and probability of event triggers, with improved notifications when events occur.

[h3]【Bug Fixes and Optimizations】[/h3]

Fixed an issue where giving alcohol to deterred barbarians caused abnormal behavior.

Fixed an issue where the Poisonous Fog effects from Fang Tribe leaders could occasionally persist.

Corrected unintended tribe attribute bonuses in the Snow Mountain, Wasteland, and Volcano regions.

Fixed an issue where carrying a barbarian could sometimes cause animation glitches.

Optimized the portal teleportation list interface.

Optimized the spawn logic for Armadillo Lizard and Llama cubs.

Fixed an issue where the boar mount would incorrectly attack.

Fixed an issue where the Tempest Griffin's grab skill would still increase hitstun even when the grab failed.

Corrected navigation to Tech Tree blueprints through the Crafting interface.

Fixed an issue where the inventory-preserving Crafting queue sometimes did not move to the end when materials were insufficient.

Fixed an issue where tribesmen did not store crafted items from the previous queue in storage boxes when the Crafting queue was reordered due to insufficient materials.

Fixed an issue causing captives to occasionally spawn outside the tribe cage.

Fixed an issue preventing tribesmen from using certain NPC-accessible doors.

Fixed an issue where the Luminous Waist Lamp would disappear during climbing.

Fixed an issue where tribesmen pathfinding could not pass through single doors.

[h2]The Description of New Server Type - PvP No Raid Server[/h2]

In response to the requests from many of you, we are excited to introduce a new type of official servers - the PvP No Raid server! On this server, players can freely engage in PvP activities while buildings under the protection of a burning Bonfire will be immune to attacks. For those who enjoy intense battles, you can now fully unleash your fighting spirit and experience exhilarating combat without any concerns!

To provide a better gaming experience, the server will undergo maintenance. It will be temporarily unavailable starting from December 5, at 7:00 AM UTC, with an expected downtime 30 minutes. This update includes a client update, and chieftains will need to update their client to enjoy the game normally. We are very grateful for your understanding and support.

The update details are as follows:

[h3]【Adjustments and Bug Fixes】[/h3]

Fixed an issue where the Hunting Gallery did not display the correct trap bait for moose.

Optimized weapon clipping issues when reviving a downed target.

Fixed an issue where the number of giant elephants could exceed the population limit.

Fixed an issue where mounts would follow from a distance after the player’s suicide.

Reduced the level of Plunderer Explorers in the Snow Mountain Dungeon, from 65 to 60 and slightly increased their health.

Fixed an issue with prolonged burning weapons sound effects.

Increased randomness in crafting quality for gliders.

Fixed an issue where AI using the Mastery skill "Fixed Pole" would sometimes fail to end the skill.

Fall damage reduction increased for giant elephants.

Fixed an issue where unlocked skins still displayed the required materials.

Fixed an issue where giant elephants could not return via player-created portals.

Fixed an issue where sled models would sometimes persist after being removed.

notes.title: Soulmask Annual Update is OUT NOW! Big Sale, New Mounts, Free DLC And More!
notes.content:
[h1]Hop on your mount and get ready to rush![/h1]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2646460/view/7167010336494584030?l=english][b]After nearly 800 updates and six months of Early Access[/b][/url], Soulmask is about to blow your mind with the most exciting update of the year!
[previewyoutube=5dJ3nE5Zo7Y;full][/previewyoutube]
Welcome to "Wild Ride" - our biggest and most transformative update for Soulmask. We've packed every feature we've been dreaming of into one massive release. Get ready - this update will revolutionize your Soulmask experience!

[h3][b]And there's more good news: we're launching our biggest sale ever with 20% off on Midweek Deal and Autumn Sale! There's never been a better time to join the adventure![/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/c7b0395496aaa6837dcfee07ee8704c3c843974c.jpg[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2646460/Soulmask/

Let's cut to the chase and dive into [b]what makes "Wild Ride" special:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h2][b]New Mounts, New Ways to Explore[/b][/h2]

Tired of your trusty llamas and big cats? We hear you! We've reimagined how chieftains explore the world of Soulmask with some exciting new additions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/18bbb44ff8158d7fbe96533a6415a85983b05ab8.png[/img]

For us, mounts aren't just about getting from A to B - they're about expanding possibilities. They can be your cargo carrier, tactical weapon, or even your mobile home.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/7c60387f4ccfd6dbe8595574095eb201ee29a548.png[/img]
Introducing our grandest mount yet - the Elephant! Based on one of Soulmask's largest creatures, this versatile mount offers unprecedented functionality. Want to enjoy a hot spring on the move? Rule from a mobile throne? Share hot cocoa with your tribesmen? The platform supports almost everything from your camp - and yes, it doubles as a formidable siege weapon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/dbd5c644177095133603d6b34dcc633c1d8f497e.png[/img]
Looking for something more adventurous? Meet our new Gliders! Unlike ostriches, these beauties harness wind currents for sustained flight. Your airtime is limited only by your skill!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/965e21e485d48b4ac5297b3745224d37257d8722.png[/img]
The world feels smaller from up high, doesn't it? But that's just the beginning of what "Wild Ride" has to offer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/9ede6e94ac0659e5313f676b6c4c00417dca21c6.gif[/img]
And with the holiday season approaching, we're adding some winter-themed features: Reindeer from the snow mountains are joining your stable of mounts! These magnificent creatures can pull specially designed sleds, perfect for transporting friends or cargo through snowy terrain. Time to hit the slopes, adventurers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/befd80c0cf9a5abbc158c14ef30fbb753a58225c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h2][b]New Items - Igniter & Gas Canister[/b][/h2]

You probably remember the signature move of the Flint Tribe leaders:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/3ef70cd63932610a74c7a5e9e3da063a5655c865.gif[/img]

Well, after countless battles, chiefs have finally mastered their technology! [i][b]You can now spray fuel on weapons and ignite them for devastating flame attacks:[/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/d1e1932e378f8ccc21dcd17334b086d5317c8de0.gif[/img]
Let’s hope your enemies won’t suffer too much! This attack has a chance to inflict multiple debuffs on your enemies, including defense reduction and slow stamina recovery—happy hunting!

We've also got another tool for tormenting your enemies: the new Gas Canister! It rapidly raises your enemy’s toxin gauge. Those pesky archers won't have anywhere to hide now.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h2][b]New Map Events - Plunderer Events & New Boss[/b][/h2]

Through your fearless exploration, the true face of this world has been revealed to your tribesmen. But you're not alone in your pursuits - the ruthless Plunderers have grown bolder, their expeditions to ancient ruins more frequent than ever. Armed with discovered ancient technologies, they seek to dominate these lands, and their expedition tracks are now plain to see. Meanwhile, the tribes are racing to secure resources, strengthening and arming themselves for what's to come. [b]Look there - another mining convoy moves across the horizon, heavy with precious cargo![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/ccc82b672588b839a2c36bc85814313e6dbb9da3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/754317916f6e6db3bb1693b87318cbe13b86e1f2.jpg[/img]
Whatever happens, this is a golden opportunity for all chieftains - keep your eyes on those new markers on the world map! Whether you're catching Plunderers with their guard down after their successful raids, or stumbling upon the chaos of Plunderers and tribal transport teams crossing paths, we must seize every chance. Don't hesitate, make your move! You'll find massive mineral deposits, precious ancient artifacts, premium weapons, gear and tools, plus those extra special rewards like rare mount cubs and high-quality gliders!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/37ac8acc29fe9f5affd3c970cc3f743deb7478c4.jpg[/img]

Of course, they're prepared for your "visit." Tribal expeditions come with powerful barbarian escorts (perfect recruitment targets!), while Plunderer Ruins expeditions are more devious - they hide additional guards nearby, ready to ambush from all directions!

Among them is the Plunderers' new leader - Shadowblade, an assassination machine never before seen by chieftains. Using "Shadow Walker" stealth abilities, she vanishes mid-battle to perform deadly blade dances from behind...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/151f3e25ad08e55b72a155312d74e61011a5aac6.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/af2a7efe80896291dce57f3defa5b53a940b6092.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h2][b]New Feature - Honor Arena[/b][/h2]

If you're ready to prove the true mettle of your mightiest tribesmen, your chance has come. T[i][b]he honor arena, forged through the alliance of the three great tribes[/b][/i], is about to open its gates. Send your finest warriors to claim victory!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/b46481b09b1719e2ca1c45368d69f548fe5c6f89.png[/img]
Elite warriors from all three tribes, sorted by skill level, await in their respective arena zones. From common tribal warriors to chieftain candidates, your tribesmen will face their toughest challenges yet - including some formidable opponents you've never encountered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/853a7595684e4516e513b56cf44985a3dbb4023f.png[/img]
As inter-clan competition rules prevent chieftains from entering personally, [i][b]choose your strongest tribesmen and equip them to the teeth![/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/48ecfdd9a91aef71b74675c2b9c106fdcbc2e3da.gif[/img]
The rewards won't disappoint: beyond rich material rewards, exclusive new emotes will help you stand out among your peers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/7cf9b3355601bd167929a9e71945c8386881cee0.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h2][b]New Feature - Advanced Animal Breeding[/b][/h2]

Outgrowing your capybaras? Your farm is about to welcome some exciting new additions! "Wild Ride" introduces the [b]new "Large Beast Trap," perfect for capturing baby bison, giant elephants, and moose.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/68b22ee61322c98d0451a96c3dcf2cecc5eee376.png[/img]
You can also find giant eggs from tortoises and horned eagles in the wild. Carefully avoid the watchful parents, sneak them home... and you'll have adorable baby tortoises and horned eagles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/f30fa165bdfbc4f769cb1161b3f7d7ace62e2e78.gif[/img]
These new companions not only provide premium animal resources but add wonderful variety to your settlement. I myself love watching the baby tortoises waddle around camp now... adding a peaceful rhythm between your battles and adventures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/45d5b7a2b75323a00d4fc42a55f9532e9e1909ba.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h2][b]New Free DLC: Cozy Tribe Decoration Pack[/b][/h2]

Hope it's not too cold where you are! (Except for Chiefs in the Southern Hemisphere, of course) We've prepared a special thanksgiving gift. Launching alongside "Wild Ride" comes Soulmask's first DLC: The Cozy Tribe Decoration Pack - and yes, it's completely free!

[h3][b]This winter-themed decoration pack brings exciting construction updates:[/b][/h3]

[b]Obsidian Construction Series[/b]: Our first new building material, cooled volcanic rock that keeps out every bit of winter chill;

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/4e97705434ae2aadc54dc15e97e29394c40579cd.png[/img]
[b]Winter Interior Decorations[/b]: From hearths to rugs to cozy two-person fur beds - everything you need for the perfect chieftain's winter lifestyle

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/e1438ffd61ad581c9ae40d25c23cec1e99df0fb9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/5ccb5dda618d1fbe9f4287f1ff4ef025587e8e77.png[/img]
[b]Outdoor Decorations[/b]: If your settlement feels too monotonous, our decorative plants can bring a touch of any biome you miss. Prefer cave mushrooms or riverside reeds?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/3aff1afd9202cbc9bb9afaddd9ee3cdc3f8d1eee.png[/img]
Which is your favorite? Whatever it is, you can have it all today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3336600/SoulmaskCozy_Tribe_Theme_Pack/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h2][b]New Feature: Photo Mode[/b][/h2]

Want to preserve those breathtaking views? Now you have better tools! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/68d1a2e155277eb6634d1af3398405bd6797e5e0.png[/img]
The new photo mode in "Wild Ride" lets you freeze time anywhere you want to capture memories. Adjust your angle and showcase the best sides of Soulmask's world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/b7833a7ddc4b76afd3f5a8e4c18defadbbba43ae.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/0e620fc52af13f24fb4ccf8ba1a0e705ad3848bb.jpg[/img]
[i][b]*Love this angle?[/b][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h2][b]New Optimization: Controller Support[/b][/h2]
Yes, it took some time, but we've delivered on our promise!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/eb76136bce5149ed8665936eaf065ac814568020.jpg[/img]
We've thoroughly optimized controller support for all game interfaces, with fully customizable button mapping for every screen. We hope this provides a better experience for controller users.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/edb3b8502c70fd34e8e3f5c2894c98e6194018e0.jpg[/img]
[b]Of course, we'll continue improving controller support - please keep your feedback coming, chieftains![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h2][b]New Event: Twitch™ Live Drops[/b][/h2]

We've prepared something special for all Soulmask streaming enthusiasts - from November 25th to January 2nd, we're partnering with [url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/category/mystery-mask-the-immortal-soul][b]Twitch™ to bring you exclusive Soulmask Drops[/b][/url]: unique glider and sled skins!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/355bb187435ad087ea7ca4928b0aec96e3a222eb.gif[/img]
To get these one-of-a-kind mount decorations, simply watch any Soulmask stream with the "DropsEnabled" tag for the specified duration!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/3db9d4baabf4dea1e49483dbe12b5e7450233063.png[/img]
For Twitch™ streamers, just add the "DropsEnabled" tag while streaming Soulmask to participate in our campaign and attract more viewers!

It's that simple - maybe it's time to check in on your favorite Soulmask streamers?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h2][b]Is That ALL?[/b][/h2]

Of course not! We have many more updates and improvements. You can find the complete details here:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2646460/view/4443459004907128923][h3]>>>Click to the Detailed Changelog<<<
[/h3][/url]

[b]Now there's only one thing left to do: jump into the game and experience the new Soulmask for yourself![/b]

notes.content:
Dear Chieftains,

To provide a better gaming experience, the server will undergo maintenance. It will be temporarily unavailable starting from November 25, at 7:00 AM UTC, with an expected downtime 1 hour. This update includes a client update, and chieftains will need to update their client to enjoy the game normally. We are very grateful for your understanding and support.

[u][b][h3]The free DLC "Cozy Tribe Theme Pack" is now available! Don't forget to add it to your collection, Chieftains![/h3][/b][/u]

The update details are as follows:

[h3]【New Features and Adjustments】[/h3]

Added a weapon ignition feature: ignite your weapon by crafting and using flammable alcohol, adding a burning effect to your attacks.

Added wild boar, moose, and giant elephant mounts, along with their saddles, and the ability to capture their juveniles.

Introduced new sleds and giant elephant saddles that can carry passengers and unconscious barbarians, along with attachable accessories.

[b]New Giant Elephant Deck Saddle[/b]

1.Items Supported on the Deck Saddle:

2. This Deck Saddle is a first test release: Considering its potential impact on the PvP environment, the Deck Saddle cannot currently be carried across servers.
Chieftains, take heed:
3. Chieftains, take note: Times have changed! Walls that were once reliable defenses can now be easily scaled. Be prepared for the new dynamics of PvP battles!

Added a new structural component: Deck Fence, which can be built on the Giant Elephant deck saddle.

Added four new types of enclosures for raising Tortoises, Armadillo Lizards, Bisons, and Horned Eagles.

Introduced large traps to capture juvenile giant elephants, bison, and moose.

Added wild spawns for horned eagle eggs and tortoise eggs.

Introduced a new beehive product: bee larvae, which can be used to feed Armadillo Lizards.

Added new randomly triggered events: enabled by default, there is a chance to trigger various barbarian or plunderer events from 18:00 to 24:00 in all regions.

Added the tribe transport squad event: enabled by default, a transport squad from one of the three tribe fortresses will spawn multiple times daily between 20:00 and 24:00 in all regions.

Added a new plunderer dual-blade boss: Shadow Blade, appearing multiple times in various locations daily between 20:30 and 24:00 in all regions.

Added a special event: enabled by default in Master difficulty mode, requires manual activation in other modes. New players are advised to enable cautiously.

Added five neutral arenas located in the Rainforest, Hill, Highland, Wasteland, and Snow Mountain.
Added a batch of gestures as rewards for completing challenges in neutral arenas.

Added new slate recipes: Nightstone Series Structures, Beast Hide Rug, Textile Rug, Fire Pit, Stone Fireplace, Blackstone Fireplace, Rainproof Campfire, Luxurious Double Bed, Flint Tribe Totem Pole, Fang Tribe Totem Pole, Claw Tribe Totem Pole, Decorative Greenery (Cavern, Meadow, Hills, Rainforest, Snow Mountain, Wetland, River Valley, Volcano).

[b]New Glider Item Introduced[/b]

This is the first test release of the glider.

Chieftains, take note: Times have changed! Walls that once provided solid defense can now be easily scaled. Be prepared to adapt in PvP battles!

Added new glider skins.

Added new sled skins.

A new "Set Additional Storage Box" function has been added to the crafting table, allowing players to select boxes outside the crafting table's range but within the same bonfire's coverage area for additional item storage.

Added Poison Gas Can for PVP combat.

Added a new exclusive Claw Tribe affix "Raging Inferno."

Added new general affixes "Spreading Flames" and "Fire Deterrence."

Added new general negative affixes "Flame Fear" and "Flame of Friendship."

Added new title affixes "The Unburned" and "The Flammable."

Modified the "Fatal Rhythm" affix to grant a bonus when the character's attack hits and stamina is above 70%.

Added introduction animations for five major bosses.

Increased the chances for Red and Golden quality tribesmen to gain advanced attributes.

Optimized Single-player Construction Mode: the player character is now hidden, construction mode can only be enabled within the bonfire range, and construction mode automatically exits when the character is attacked.

Improved the conversion efficiency of the Mystery Converter and added support for converting various seeds, spoiled meat, feathers, and stone bricks.

The Powered Cutting Machine now supports crafting Blackstone Bricks.

Optimized the animation of hammer executions for targets.

Players cannot lock onto targets while using the Dual-blade Flurry skill.

Hammer Charge Attack no longer has a pulling effect.

Medium Traps can now be used to capture small boars.

Small Traps can now be used to capture juvenile Armadillo Lizards.

Mounting and dismounting speed has been increased.

The Repair Bench now supports retrieving materials from nearby chests.

The Mask Decor Table now supports retrieving materials from nearby chests.

Weight adjustments have been made for some structures.

The limit on the number of Ballista Towers within the bonfire range has been increased from 12 to 15.


[h3]【Bug Fixes and Optimizations】[/h3]

Controller Optimizations: Removed the virtual cursor and replaced it with D-pad and left joystick navigation.

Optimized climbing actions.

Climbing Optimization: Weapons are now hidden instead of being sheathed.

Sprint Optimization: When interrupted by hitstun, holding the button allows sprinting to resume once hitstun ends.

Roll and Mastery Skill Recovery Optimizations: Improved for smoother skill transitions.

Fixed an issue where AI would not move when using the Mastery skill "Moon Sacrifice."

Fixed an issue where AI would not perform consecutive thrusts after blocking with the Shield-Blade combination.

Fixed an issue where AI would not use Mastery skills "Low Strike" and "Blood Sacrifice."

Fixed an issue where humanoid bosses were not affected by the Bleed effect.

Optimized Burn and Ignite Visual Effects: Improved for all animals.

Fixed an issue where the dust effect from Vajra Ape of Doom would sometimes persist.

Fixed an issue preventing tribesmen from using their weapons normally after being released from control.

Fixed a rare issue where tribesmen could not move after sleeping.

Fixed a visual issue where barbarians in mines could sometimes be invisible when deterred.

Fixed an issue that allowed Explosive and Combustion Can Traps to be stacked in certain situations.

notes.title: Developer's Update: Soulmask EA Six-Month Progress Report
notes.content:
[h2]Hi Chieftains![/h2]

Maggie here, sending my greetings! I hope you're all doing well as you explore the vast world of Soulmask and uncover the secrets of ancient civilizations!

As Soulmask nears the 6-month mark in Early Access, we thought it’s a great time to look back on the journey so far and share some of the major updates we’ve made. Whether you’ve already donned the mysterious mask or are just diving in, take a moment to check out the massive changes we've made over the last half-year, where constructed together with your feedback.

Let's get straight to the point: In these nearly 6 months, [i][b]we've implemented 748 improvements[/b][/i]. Even we were amazed by this achievement!

This achievement wouldn’t have been possible without the feedback from every single one of you. While Soulmask has its own vision, it’s your insights that have truly helped make it better.

I've been considering how to make our updates more noticeable for everyone. So, we decided to show you a direct comparison between the issues players raised six months ago and how we've addressed them in the latest version of Soulmask.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h2]Solo Play Difficulty[/h2]

Since Soulmask launched in Early Access, one of the less favorable impressions has been regarding the difficulty of the single-player mode.

We're committed to addressing this issue for our players as quickly as possible! That's why feedback on difficulty has been our top priority. Let's take a look at the improvements we've made for solo players over the past six months!

[h3][b]Enhancing the Main Character[/b][/h3]

The issue of the main character being too weak has been one of the biggest points of contention since day one.

We understand the importance of a strong main character for solo players. Previously, the original main character felt underwhelming with low stats and no passive skills, making them easily replaceable by any random tribesmen. To address this, we've introduced an exciting new system:

[b]DNA Replication:[/b] With just a few resources, you can now upgrade your character’s body to match the abilities of your strongest tribesmen!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/047407a85e533e6b5b372ad8b093a856ded1f17f.gif[/img]

And the best part? You can replicate their abilities multiple times, allowing you to switch between different powerful builds as you fight on the front lines!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/6c06899c25cab4178a5a76ab61728e575ae7561e.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Reducing Death Penalties:[/b][/h3]

Shortly after Early Access release, Soulmask quickly earned a reputation as a "Souls-like survival game," known for the especially harsh death penalties in dungeons.

In response, we’ve added respawn points throughout major dungeons so that players can restart from checkpoints.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/d2c82fc4979f40c01d9405e4c291ba9c0ac4be03.jpg[/img]

We've also addressed the frustrating experience of losing all progress when premium tribesmen died. Now you can perfectly preserve your tribesmen with the Perfect Remodel feature - save their best state at any time and revive them directly at campfires!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/cceabab8cbc70b6f419d00748bf1e34faf6d42fe.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Combat Mechanics Improvements:[/b][/h3]

Another major issue players faced was the overly repetitive AI commands that could make enemies feel predictable. We’ve updated the AI of most human enemies to make them behave more realistically. While still dangerous, they now use their attacks more strategically, reducing the frustration of facing unfair tactics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/e6be2db48cb9100e31da1d0edc74a741c904751c.gif[/img]

We’ve also introduced a new skill called Recover Sense, which helps you recover quickly from hitstuns during battle. This is especially helpful when fighting multiple enemies, as it gives you more room to breathe and recover.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/acde339fa3c42ccd1840fd0b88ee432734d170cd.gif[/img]

For the beasts, we’ve reduced the [b]spawn density of dangerous creatures[/b], such as the Jaguar, on the early maps. We’ve also moved the infamous Anaconda to a small island—so long as you avoid them, they won’t bother you!

[h3][b]System Balancing:[/b][/h3]

After careful consideration about smoothing the single-player experience, we've adjusted various game values. The difficulty curve across all high-level areas, from volcanoes to snow mountains, has been modified - you can now survive and progress in late-game areas even with modest gear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/47870ff3d4e6008d4d0239b341c013e2e9ff4f85.gif[/img]

We’ve also addressed some of the previously annoying drop issues, such as those with rubber and other essential materials. Plus, we’ve updated the enemy spawn mechanics in dungeons and barracks, creating a more balanced and enjoyable solo experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h2]Teleport and Travel[/h2]

We haven't forgotten the feedback from our first week after launch. Many of you loved the beauty of our vast map but found the long travel times frustrating. We clearly underestimated your eagerness to explore! So, we’ve been hard at work improving the system.

[h3][b]Teleport and Travel[/b][/h3]

Originally, we had portals scattered across regions, but they just didn’t feel frequent enough, especially for dungeons. A failed run could lead to long trekking back.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/a21ae8ae0d664ed7957069da25feba163a36f85f.gif[/img]

So we've restructured the map's portal network - they're now more densely distributed at key locations. No more lengthy journeys just to farm high-level materials!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/20cda9f3ffa8fd07824a23157a685998398d31f1.png[/img]

We've also lowered the requirements for crafting portals, making them accessible in early-game dungeons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/12c45feed04652c8b3e8d860b90c0babd3ddeda1.jpg[/img]

Even better, custom portals can now directly connect to various ourdoor portals and teleport your followers. As player put it, "The subway now reaches your house"!

[h3][b]Mount Improvements[/b][/h3]

As our faithful companions, mounts have been one of our most discussed features. While many mount changes require more time and careful consideration, we haven't touched the core systems in these six months.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/6838a43a48365ae99ee5cceda4f8f3f7bc3ddfae.jpg[/img]

For example, we've significantly reduced the difficulty of obtaining rare mounts, and mounts can now teleport to players within a certain distance. But I know this isn't what you're most excited about -  more new travel methods are on the way!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h2]Tribesmen[/h2]

Tribesmen have been Soulmask's most distinctive feature and most beloved content since launch. Over these months, we've gradually made these followers both stronger and smarter.

[h3][b]Boosting Follower Combat Power[/b][/h3]

At the start of Early Access, our followers' combat abilities were limited. Over the past six months, we've implemented "intensive training" to enhance their skills. We've steadily improved their combat AI and stats, making them more proactive and aggressive in battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/1276633b68e8add89256439c70fe9645681fcf00.gif[/img]
Their survival ability has also improved. On normal difficulty, even if you fall, your tribesmen are more likely to stay alive and come to your rescue!

Building on these enhanced follower capabilities, we wanted to do something more ambitious: we've added tribesmen legions. If you wish, you can deploy your entire clan to assault a barbarian camp or even Holy Ruins...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/6e668bb868230f45cc6fae0f8c97b8f73f3939b1.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Tribesmen Intelligence Improvements[/b][/h3]

Ever since Soulmask's EA launch, we've been hearing your feedback about the production AI for our tribesmen. We're excited to share that we've come up with several ideas to help tribesmen manage more tasks efficiently:

● [b]We’ve added the inventory management feature[/b], so your tribesmen will automatically organize materials and resources in your storage. All you have to do is drop your gathered items in one spot, and they'll handle all the sorting and storage work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/eea531af431cc662c9c47b758d6d22b79d7841d7.jpg[/img]

● [b]We’ve also introduced the maintain inventory command[/b]. With this, your tribesmen can keep the right amounts of intermediate or finished products, ensuring you're never overstocked or understocked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/3ff26083fe3d0dc6c3bf673eabcd9e654c645715.jpg[/img]

● Lastly, [b]we've added the upgrade construction command[/b]. Select a building, issue the command, and your tribesmen will use the Construction Hammer and materials from storage to upgrade it to the higher tier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/5e2f20ec8cdaf30f8d22ba2a7e4766110866030b.jpg[/img]

Of course, we still have much to improve regarding pathfinding logic, trap avoidance during combat, and other issues. Please bear with us, we'll soon turn tribesmen into your most dependable allies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h2]A Cozier Home[/h2]

We deeply understand the importance of players' personal spaces in survival games. Over these six months, our updates to building and management systems had one goal: making it easier for players to establish a cozy home.

[h3][b]Tribal Management: Quality of Life Improvements[/b][/h3]

The new animal management interface lets you monitor your companions' status at any time, making them easier to locate and manage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/090959b5bc92c17921771b77fb10d5be15031c03.jpg[/img]

Most importantly, Soulmask players can now craft from inventory. No more running back and forth with materials - handle everything right from the workbench!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/c0cb49d3aca775a898a29e0dd22fbd9540fdb52a.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]More support construction[/b][/h3]

Next, I'd like to introduce the new construction added to Soulmask over these six months. We’ve always hoped our functional construction would genuinely solve players’ issues:

[b]Mysterious Converter[/b]: It can convert surplus low-level materials from logging and mining into high-level rare materials at set ratios! Best of all, it's fully automated - just assign tribesmen, and they'll handle the rest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/94b8f0babea8bcd6cf1d7f419b1bb682fe4e306a.gif[/img]

[b]Hibernation Pod[/b]: Due to the game’s tribe population limit, sometimes you’d miss out on excellent barbarians due to full population. Now the Hibernation Pod lets you put temporarily unused tribesmen into hibernation, saving population space while not having to abandon anyone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/3771b1fd9e77f9012958e3d710c7ad0669056db1.gif[/img]

We also have training dummies for AFK character training, treasure chests for secretly storing items in PVP battles...We hope these features let players discover more gameplay possibilities. Of course, beyond functionality, more decorative constructions are on the way, so stay tuned!

[h3][b]Building Interface Optimization[/b][/h3]

Building construction has been one of the most criticized aspects of our game. Over the past six months, we've made significant improvements, including updates to construction collision, the user interface, and material upgrades (such as the automatic upgrades mentioned in the tribesmen section). We've also implemented various other optimizations. Now, all you need is a Construction Hammer to easily create the home of your dreams.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/395b50c7f87bc697b243b2aa53f8642512b957f3.jpg[/img]

Oh, and we’ve added “Building Mode”! Press Esc to enter this mode, and you can freely fly and inspect your tribe from any angle. We hope this satisfies some super builders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/c6623034486fc2592692ede613fc2af7356205ba.gif[/img]

We have much more to say about Chieftains' houses, but let’s save the main event for late November! Now let’s discuss something you might be more interested in: [b]Mods[/b]!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h2]More Variety[/h2]

If I say customization is the soul of survival games, there shouldn’t be much controversy, whether it’s in-game freedom or community content. This was clearly a weak point when Soulmask first launched. Therefore, we’ve invested considerable effort here over these six months.

[h3][b]More Customization Options[/b][/h3]

If you got our game six months ago, you'll find the customization options have expanded dramatically:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/5929dad59b8931931b3473d491e0e6127813d96a.jpg[/img]

From building height limits to load adjustment, from sub-base numbers to tribe population caps, plus that extensive list of optional settings - while it might seem a bit complex, I can guarantee that whether you're playing solo or hoping to run your own server, we now provide enough customization choices.

And if that's not enough, we've also enabled console functions in single-player mode - whatever you want is just a mouse click away!

[h3][b]Introducing Custom Appearances[/b][/h3]

Many players noted that our late-game gear felt too uniform, with tribes becoming gatherings of "generic soldiers"... So we've added the "Gear Transmog" system. You can now obtain all appearances from common barbarians to chiefs from the game's three major hostile tribes - dress up however you like!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/a76e3fec45add939606bd0a0d62562ae21255ae0.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Mod Support[/b][/h3]

And saving the best for last - Soulmask now supports Steam Workshop! Community content from mod creators worldwide awaits your discovery.

Whether you want new construction:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/1a8039508a206d124955d2691cb30e5928a66be6.gif[/img]
[i]*Soulmask Extreme By SiberCat[/i]

Or new mounts:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/eaab6e5acadae9437881719907f179f86bc48624.gif[/img]
[i]*Mountable Bosses By Leesionto[/i]

Mods are where imagination comes to life! Or perhaps you'd like to create one yourself...?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]

Reflecting on our progress, it’s clear that many of these improvements were driven by your feedback. Soulmask wouldn’t have reached where it is today without your active participation.

More importantly, we feel this is just the beginning. We're working tirelessly to address many existing issues, and we need your feedback now more than ever!

Coming up, we have the real main event - at the end of this month, we'll bring our most substantial "Mammoth Update" since EA. Stay tuned for more news, which will be shared first with our Steam community. This is Maggie, and we can't wait to see you soon!

notes.title: Soulmask Mod Highlight #1 - October
notes.content:
[h2]Hi Chieftains![/h2]

It's only been two weeks since we launched the Steam Workshop, but the community’s creativity is already off the charts! Have any of you been as hooked as I am, spending your days riding the fierce Saber-toothed Predator and causing total mayhem in enemy tribes with the Retroreflector? If you haven't jumped in yet, trust me—you’re missing out!

But it looks like some of you haven't yet discovered all the excitement the Mods has to offer. So, let’s dive in and spotlight some of the coolest ideas coming from the Soulmask community—and, of course, give a big shout-out to the talented Mod creators making it all happen!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h3]Soulmask Extreme By [url=https://ko-fi.com/sibercat][b]SiberCat[/b][/url][/h3]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3324057706

If you're craving a totally fresh Soulmask experience, this is the Mod you’ve been waiting for. Sibercat has put together an incredible array of magical items and creatures, each with wildly unique powers. Ever dreamed of zipping around with a teleportation scroll or having an adorable magical sidekick? This Mod is your gateway to an unforgettable fantasy adventure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/1a8039508a206d124955d2691cb30e5928a66be6.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/665fa200ac996f096f31eeac45a3e20babe7f375.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h3]Lucifer's Mod Pack By [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198192223818][b]Lucifer[/b][/url][/h3]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3325146665

If you've been keeping up with our Workshop, you’ll know “Recruitable Bosses” is one of our most popular Mods right now—who wouldn’t want their own Retroreflector?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/d7653d82a2ecee3fa8f577945a49f3299ce1cfa4.gif[/img]

But Lucifer didn’t stop there! He’s also refined many production construction and tribesmen mechanics, offering you much more room for customization. These Mods might not look flashy at first glance, but trust me, once you try them, there’s no going back!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h3]Tasty Framework & Tasty Admin By [url=https://discord.gg/2rtJXww5JR][b]Noms[/b][/url][/h3]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3330908154&searchtext=
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3332634339&searchtext=

From one of our most active Discord Modders, Nomi! He’s brought us the Tasty Framework, a simple but super powerful toolset with a control panel. It features permission management, event logs, highly customizable NPC generation, and more. If you run a private server, this is a must-have—it’ll make your server way more powerful!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/24bf5cc751cf9529bda420d7ff9d3dbd49913675.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/f95c18db41e8a1f0da3ef3ca208fb89885c0c0f4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h3]Replace-Anaconda-to-Poison-frog By [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198407096597/myworkshopfiles/][b]天之霜[/b][/url] [/h3]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3339854489

Finally, the perfect solution for Chiefs who dread anacondas! This mod does exactly what its name suggests—it swaps out all the anacondas for tiny Arrow-poison Frogs. Though to be fair, both are pretty deadly…
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h3]Mountable Bosses By [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/15888771286/myworkshopfiles/][b]Leesionto[/b][/url][/h3]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3338752463&searchtext=
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3328437618&searchtext=

When I first laid eyes on the massive wingspan of the Tempest Griffin, I never thought I’d one day be soaring across the world on its back. But thanks to Leesionto’s Mod, now you can! Both the Tempest Griffin and the Saber-toothed Predator are rideable after you conquer their guardians. And it gets even better—Leesionto has also integrated their powerful skills into the mounts, so you can unleash devastating strikes while riding them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/cc31bdeef61d981963b6b1c52b37c442210e9ef5.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/eaab6e5acadae9437881719907f179f86bc48624.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h3]Boss Skill By 莉央小姐的猫[/h3]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3334306167

The powerful skills of the tribal bosses are now at your command! Thanks to "莉央小姐的猫", many Chiefs’ dreams have come true—now you can incinerate enemies with a flaming sword!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/1160b062dab93d3da0df1c1760a15380261cc9ac.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/1c646d9e1cbf1ab3ace13d0bbec8dd592bbec722.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
It’s honestly hard to narrow down the recommendations when there’s so much great community content rolling out every day—every Mod is worth checking out!

And if you’re feeling inspired, we’d love for you to join the ranks of Mod creators. If you’re not sure where to start, head over to our Wiki for a guide on Modkits. We can’t wait to see what you bring to Soulmask!

This is Maggie, and I’ll be back next month with more Soulmask Mod picks. See you then!

notes.title: TGS2024｜Soulmask Major Themed DLC Concept Teaser
notes.content:

This update includes a client update, and chieftains will need to update their client to enjoy the game normally. notes.title: Developer's Update: Major Update Preview - Fantastic Cheiftains
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, chieftains![/h3]

It's been two months since our first major update, "Evolution of Masks," and I bet we're not the only ones itching for some fresh changes in Soulmask!

Our second major update is coming soon, and the theme is "Fantastic Chieftains"! This update brings a lot of exciting features, from the Chiefs themselves to the new mysterious arena, and also the Steam Workshop that offers endless possibilities (you've probably seen our teaser on this already!). Soulmask will be filled with even more potential with this major update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/9217efef8a6c1068db475a339f4a6030ca90ca50.jpg[/img]
First up, I've got something special for all you bloodthirsty warriors out there—your very own battleground...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[b][h3]1. New Gameplay: Ancient Dungeon Arena[/h3][/b]

[i]A new arena is opening soon for the chosen chieftains—loot, fight, and claim ancient blessings in this fierce arena.... This is part of the sacrifice.
[/i]
——[b]Ancient tablet hidden in the shadows[/b]

That's right, a new battleground dedicated to PvP combat is coming soon. I know your weapons have been thirsty for action for a while now. In our second major update, "Fantastic Chieftains," we're introducing new building blueprints to everyone’s mask, including the most exciting one—the Arena Portal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/d9c4484be02f157afc20fa1504729c07ec326dbd.gif[/img]
On official PvP servers, the Arena Portal will open at specific times each day, inviting every chieftain to enter. You'll dive into a completely randomized dungeon to claim relics from the ancient, mysterious civilization. But watch your back - other chieftains are after the same prize. Only one can walk away with the ultimate reward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/ac5bf9fa4c6a9f7a49ddf770c901f396f9781e62.gif[/img]
These dungeons, remnants of ancient times, are filled with dangers—twisting mazes, deadly traps, terrifying ancient Slayers, and Plunderers lurking in the shadows, waiting to strike. The heart of the dungeon hides its greatest threats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/0fb1c5d11ae79123e8e398586f0d56a851167dfd.gif[/img]
There are many ways to survive: stay hidden and swoop in when the coast is clear, assist the dungeon monsters in taking down your competition, or just swing your weapon and cut down everyone in your way. But time is ticking—the deadly radiation walls are closing in, destroying everything in their path. Either you escape, or you die.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/8fae0d602abde1c7e904569ee504bf7f8395c638.gif[/img]
The abundance of rare ancient/mysterious gear and their precious repair kits in the dungeon's treasure chests make all the danger worthwhile—this is one of only two places in Soulmask where such weapons can be found. As for the 3rd-tier modify materials or other rare resources from the ruins, they might be overkill for ENDGAME players, but for newcomers? These could be game-changers—if you can make it out alive, that is!

A dangerous, treasure-filled PvP dungeon is thrilling for some, but not everyone enjoys constant bloodshed. Don't worry, we’ve got plenty of fun in store for those who prefer a different path!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[b][h3]2. New Feature: Skin Decoration[/h3][/b]

First, let’s answer this question: why the name "Fantastic Chieftains"?

You guessed it! Starting with "Fantastic Chieftains" update, we're finally making one of our long-time dreams a reality: letting chieftains change their look in countless ways. In the new version, allowing all our tribesmen to customize their appearance. The mask Decor Table will feature a new "Skin Decoration" option, letting you transform into any character from the three major tribes, from the lowliest laborer to the top boss.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/a76e3fec45add939606bd0a0d62562ae21255ae0.gif[/img]
Blueprints for these skins can be obtained from craftsmen in the three main tribes or found in chests guarded by BOSS. Once you learn a skin blueprint, you can craft the corresponding skins. Want your tribe's warriors to cosplay as a Retroreflector? Just remember, they won’t come with Retroreflector’s signature "Execution" move...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/c97a9bb79167b2aeb7bdc34e1861542cbc93b30a.gif[/img]
PvP enthusiasts, a heads-up! With this feature, you’ll never know if that scrappy warrior in ragged tribe gear is actually a top-tier fighter wearing the best armor. Never judge a book by its cover—assume everyone's a threat. We'll be keeping a close eye on how this system plays out, so hit us up with your feedback anytime.

This new feature is just the tip of the iceberg for the "Fantastic Chieftains" update. Brace yourselves for a slew of wild new buildings!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[b][h3]3. Tons of New Constructions![/h3][/b]

[b]New Construction: Chief’s Chair[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/d75facf8d7c6b9feb30ea9a2d855d8d0b8d7315b.gif[/img]
We need more ways to maintain your Chiefs' majesty. How about a huge high-back chair? In the "Fantastic Chieftains" update, the "Chief’s Chair" will be your exclusive seat, highlighting your supreme status. Just remember to turn off the [Allow tribesmen to use] option, or... well, you might not like what happens.

[b]New Construction: Treasure Bag/Treasure Chest[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/b12d0addc8a8f78e364cb58dc5c44463de209230.png[/img]
Concerned about losing all your treasures in tribal wars? Now, with Treasure Bags and Treasure Chests, you can hide your tribe’s emergency supplies underground. It’s your last line of defense, giving you a chance to rebuild if disaster strikes.

[b]New Construction: Training Dummy[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/12d6cad1b382d4e41487026759ff98e141e9637e.gif[/img]
I know you’re tired of killing thousands of boars or bison to train your tribesmen’s weapon skills. In the "Fantastic Chieftains" update, our tribesmen have mastered advanced dummy-making techniques. Now, they can create new training dummies that help them improve their weapon skills over time.

[b]New Construction: Mysterious Converter[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/94b8f0babea8bcd6cf1d7f419b1bb682fe4e306a.gif[/img]
Unofficial statistics reveal that 90% of tribes' storage boxes are always filled with various stones and branches collected by tribesmen. Most chiefs have moved past the "headache of how to deal with them" stage and just ignore this junk.

But what if I told you we could turn that trash into treasure?

Introducing our new construction, the “Mysterious Converter” This ancient technology can transform any material into Bloodstones, Blood Crystals, and other rare relic civilization artifacts! This machine, which once made the ancient civilization incredibly powerful, is now in your hands.

You can even set it up with your tribe's management system to keep your material stocks just how you like them. Too much of something? Your tribesmen will automatically toss the excess into the Mysterious Converter for a bit of "recycling magic."

[b]New Construction: Hibernation Pod[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/3771b1fd9e77f9012958e3d710c7ad0669056db1.gif[/img]
Ever found the perfect legendary tribesmen, only to realize your mask's link limit is maxed out? Forcing you to kick that loyal buddy who's been with you since day one to the curb? Trust me, you're not alone in that heartbreak.

In the "Fantastic Chieftains" update, chiefs acquire advanced body-freezing technology from the mask, introducing a new construction: the low-temperature Hibernation Pod. This innovation lets you temporarily hibernate any barbarians that exceed the mask's maximum link limit. Think of it as your personal Valhalla—you can store your elite warriors and preserve old allies for a special occasion. You might even use it to discipline your tribesmen... though tossing them in front of a Vajra Ape might be more effective.

We hope these new features bring a fresh wave of excitement to Soulmask. And this is just the beginning—there’s more constructions to come!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[b][h3]See you on September 26th![/h3][/b]

From the new and unpredictable threats in the random battlefields to the diverse looks introduced by the new costume system, and the endless possibilities offered by the Steam Workshop, we hope the "Fantastic Chieftains" major update brings a richer gaming experience to all chiefs.

And believe us, there's still more to come! Stay tuned for more details soon. See you on September 26th!

Dear Chieftains,

To provide a better gaming experience, the server will undergo maintenance. It will be temporarily unavailable starting from September 12, at 7:00 AM UTC, with an expected downtime of 45 minutes. notes.title: Soulmask Post-Reset New Server Plans
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Chieftains:[/h2]

Following the announcement of our plan to reset PVP season, we heard many speculations regarding related issues, so we decided to both clarify and discuss future plans in this post.
The purpose of any official server is to provide consistent gaming experience. As the player base grows, we see the different demands and desires among players, and therefore, we aim to diversify server types to meet these varied needs.
We know some players want a faster-paced PVP experience, so this time we have added servers that reset monthly and increased multipliers for those seeking quicker progression and more fast-paced PVP.
We’ve also introduced certain themed servers for testing purposes, which will help us better understand your needs. For example, weekend PVP servers are for players with a busy weekday schedule, and hardcore PVP servers for those who want to challenge themselves to the limit! We welcome brave players like you to take on this challenge!
Furthermore, we've planned to set up long-term beta-testing servers that do not reset player data after a season. Of course, we’ll evaluate and make adjustments during the Early Access phase. We’ll announce any changes at least three months in advance.

[url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1tuc6Gbr9KLYdmPUIq9RfGiPPhpQyuYwjXZryQ2_1G-M/edit?usp=sharing][b]First Server Types Planned in Next Week[/b][/url](Available in Asia, North America, Europe; the reset plan for South America and Oceania to be determined based on practical situation after the regional season):

[b]PVP Servers:[/b]
● PVP Test Server - 4-Player Tribe – monthly reset – 4-hour raids
● PVP Test Server – 10-Player Tribe – monthly reset – 4-hour raids
● PVP Test Server – 4-Player Tribe – tri-monthly reset – 2-hour raids
● PVP Test Server – 10-Player Tribe – tri-monthly reset – 2-hour raids
