notes.title: Soulmask FAST Q＆A 08
notes.content:
[h2]Hi Chieftains：[/h2]

Looks like it’s been a while since our devs had a good chat with you all. But if you’ve been keeping up with our updates, you’ll know we’re always tuned in to what you need.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2646460/view/4585314779400913573

Thanks to all your detailed feedback, we've identified even more ways to make Soulmask better. Today, we’re diving into some of the hot topics raised in the player community. Curious about what's new and what's coming up in Soulmask? This post’s got you covered!

I know you’re not here for small talk, so let’s get right to it:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h3][b]1.[i]@BeastMama[/i]: Most i've run the lvl 50 Ancient Dungeons, and after around 30 runs i ended up with only 4 legendary items, this is so disappointing.[/b][/h3]

A:  The first question comes from our familiar Chieftains——No worries! We’ve tweaked things so you’ll find more legendary gear dropping now... Keep up the carnage!

[h3][b]2. [i]@aryyn[/i]: "I think we should be able to have a better choice when farming mysterious gear. Yes its "mysterious" but Im not seeing myself farming the dungeon over 50 times or something to get a better set than the craftable, which is then not even repairable"[/b][/h3]

A: We hear you loud and clear! Starting with the near future update, some of the higher-ups in the barbarian camp[b] have figured out a few tricks to repair mysterious gear.[/b] Maybe you should go and “require” them to share their secrets with you?

[h3][b]3.[i]@Quarinah/@Amastris[/i]:“please add cotton seed to the list of the oil press. i get a tremendous amount of seeds from growing the cotton i need for yarn and all the other cotton items but i can only use the seeds to replant cotton. irl cotton seed oil is used in cooking throughout many asian countries so its not farfetched to use cottonseed oil for the oil press”

[i]@Mecc[/i]："Can we add pineapple to the fruits to make acidic fluid? And it would make sense since guava has a pH level between 3.08–4.38Tomatoes have a pH level between 4.0 and 4.5. And pineapples have one between 3–4 so it would fit into that category. I can use Guava and Tomatoes but not pineapple"[/b][/h3]

A：We’ve gotta hand it to you, Quarinah, Amastris and Mecc—you gave us a quick lesson in practical science! So, taking your feedback to heart, we’ve made some changes: now you can use cottonseed in the oil press, and pineapple can be used for making acidic fluid now!

[h3][b]4. [i]@aryyn[/i]: "Its so cramped and I only have comfort level 8. I dont want to use only mammoth horns or spam more heads into 1 small place to get comfort 10. It also needs to look good."[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/ee95e42ef3eaefe0a657bc43b448aef2273deee8.png[/img]
[b][i]*“Oh no...”[/i][/b]

A: The moment our building system designer saw your post, they knew something had to change—big thanks, aryyn! We’ve now expanded the comfort radius to 30 meters, giving you plenty of space to create a beautiful and comfortable home.

[h3][b]5. [i]@I__am__who[/i]: “In the Work Manage Crafting Tables, in the Work Location list (where you can set the priority of the workbench being used) can you show which workbench the tribesmen is currently using so we can identify how much longer til their off that particular job?”[/b][/h3]

A: Gotcha! We’re on it, adding this feature so you can track each tribesmen’s work log and better manage their tasks.

[h3][b]6. [i]@D3m0nDreamer[/i]: “First person view, even if it is only togglable for building, would be a game changer for many. It is very difficult to center anything without playing guessing games after a few dozen tries on a relocate.“[/b][/h3]

A: A lot of you have been asking for a first-person view, and we're listening. It might take some time, but we’re working on bringing this feature to life as soon as we can. For instance, this will be added to the game as similar as using camera mode.
For the constructions themselves, though, we think a simple first-person view might not fully solve the issue, so we’re exploring better options, such as the unique structure mode...

[h3][b]7.[i] @Matthew[/i]:"I would like to suggest an enhancement to the current NPC production system. It would be incredibly useful if the NPCs with workstations could be programmed to produce items based on the inventory levels in the base. For instance, an NPC could be set to produce ropes only when the total number of ropes in all the chests across the base falls below a specified threshold, such as 100. The NPC would then continue to produce ropes until the inventory is replenished to the desired level.[/b][/h3]

A: Great minds think alike, Matthew! This idea has been on our radar for a while. We’ve always wanted to add a “maintenance work” feature for tribesmen, but it’s a bit tricky to develop. The good news is, we’re planning to roll out this feature in Soulmask soon!

[h3][b]8.[i] @Ash[/i]: “Spear Overturn, While this spell can be countered by others such as vertical wall, it can be spammed for long period of time. Suggestion Cap how long you can hold Overturn e.g., you can only overturn for 10 sec regardless of whether you have stamina or not ”[/b][/h3]

A: We get tons of feedback on overpowered skills each week, and Spear Overturn is a hot topic. Ash’s opinion reflects the views of many players. Thanks for raising this to us anyway! But instead of just nerfing skills—which wouldn’t be fair to the players who enjoy them—we’re more interested in adding fun counterplays to maintain balance.

To counter Spear Overturn, our lead designer Royce suggests a personal favorite strategy: begin with the hammer skill 'Solar Protection' to get a Superarmor buff. Then, switch to gauntlets and use 'Revolving Kick' to drain your opponent's stamina. This approach is particularly effective against Spear Overturn, which heavily relies on stamina.

Of course, you can try other tactics to drain their stamina, like using throwables. Overall, we aim to balance Soulmask's PvP by adding more counter options rather than just tweaking numbers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
Thanks to all your awesome feedback! If you have more suggestions or ideas, drop them in the comments.

And I know many of you are eagerly awaiting our next big update.[b] The portal to the Killing Zone is about to open… [/b]you’ll get to see it soon… Stay tuned!

This is Maggie, looking forward to our next chat!

notes.title: Developer's Update: Developer Kits and Workshop
notes.content:
[h3]Hi Chieftains![/h3]

That's right, we've got some exciting news to share with you again! Recently, Maggie has been hard at work with our talented Mod creators, conducting initial tests on Mods and our developer tools. Now, we believe it's the perfect time to introduce these tools to you guys!

[b][i]Yes, in our upcoming major update at the end of September, Soulmask will officially offer user-generated content creation tool: say hello to the Devkit![/i][/b]

What can you do with the Devkit? What new UGC content can we expect for Soulmask? You'll be able to dive into all of it very soon, but for now, let's give you a sneak peek!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
First up, we're super excited to introduce our Devkit: [b]This is our newly developed Soulmask content editor, built entirely from the ground up using Unreal Engine![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/5c7e88a43fb9b948b370cc9701e2307ab7426337.png[/img]
So, what's possible with this tool? Let's start with what everyone loves—characters!

[b]NPC Modifications:[/b]

You have the freedom to modify nearly every aspect of our existing characters and creatures. This includes swapping out models (just be mindful of the poly count...), tweaking AI behaviors, altering skeletons, and even creating a custom set of animations! It’s all up to you—whether you want to make your tribesmen more dynamic or transform every creature into something entirely different. For example,  Our video director Jimmy, who has a phobia of snakes, turned the anaconda into an adorable little boar. It’s a simple, yet effective solution!

[previewyoutube=a7bYr4DS_aQ;full][/previewyoutube]
We’ve also enabled creators to design their own unique tribesman blueprints. You can use our existing skeletons or create new ones to craft your very own monsters or barbarians, complete with custom skills, AI behavior trees, loot drops, and more. Want to bring in a character from another world? Now you can!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/a2bce1ab5586e05716e6490a68aa76833cc8e2dd.gif[/img]
Finally, you can place your newly created characters wherever you like in the world. We’ll be rolling out updates for this feature soon. Whether you’re dreaming of building your own dungeon or transforming your tribesmen into something completely unexpected, the choice is yours!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/bea6fb427d23e3e4fcd07b412b2f8ca6575211ff.jpg[/img][i]Jimmy looked for many of his favourite...Hmm[/i]

[b]Construction Modifications:[/b]

Beyond NPC, construction is another area we’re deeply passionate about. You have the freedom to customize every aspect of your building components—their shape, material, and all associated properties: durability, construction requirements, collision settings, anchor points... you name it. This allows you to create your own unique architectural style and aesthetic. Whether it’s baroque, oriental, or something entirely unconventional that might not traditionally suit a rainforest setting, what truly matters is that it’s something you love!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/8af1df75a3b15ec055d578c985d1ea17d8343eff.gif[/img]
Considering a unique workbench? You can design your own recipes and functional buildings, and even introduce entirely new features if you wish. We provide a wide range of options for functional buildings. How about a vanity table where your tribesmen can change their appearance? Why not!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/447a2d7d002030358db3edc5fcb4f06531e30819.jpg[/img]
[b]Item/Gear Modifications:[/b]

Want to create your own items? Absolutely! We support custom creations for nearly all item types in Soulmask. You can define their effects using GE, set the animations for item usage, and adjust almost every post-use mechanic you can think of. I know some of you are eager to turn the portal into a usable item...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/257fed734ef72d9280ce9b1d75f4763e9aedcbe8.gif[/img]
How about a brand-new weapon or piece of armor? You have complete creative freedom! From designing the recipe and choosing the equipment slot, to customizing character animations and fine-tuning damage parameters, you can create a weapon that’s entirely your own—or even introduce a completely new weapon type! I heard someone’s interested in developing gunpowder weapons...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/3c992db0b089ecf6e390e3aecc5095c5f625b898.gif[/img]
Or maybe you're thinking of designing a new saddle? The Devkit allows you to fully customize mount saddles, including animations for mounting and dismounting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/af69749b1ea1f9a3b2d396b275e2755214212aa4.jpg[/img]
Of course, all of these creations can be tied to recipes. You can set up crafting stations, determine the required proficiency levels, and assign quality tiers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/9edc7a07f71c2544a016d4c2ab7343c65662bb5e.jpg[/img]

[b]What else is there?[/b]

If we were to list every feature of the Devkit, this developer log would turn into a ten-page manual (which, by the way, we do have!). Instead, I want to offer you a glimpse of the endless possibilities this tool provides—from crafting entirely new creatures and levels to designing whole new maps. Our goal is to give creators the freedom to bring any idea to life.

Keep in mind that the current version is still in testing, and we’ll continue to improve it based on feedback from creators like you. If you’re eager to start testing the tools and creating Mods today, we’d love to have you join our dedicated Mod creator [url=https://discord.gg/ucmMxeWHpZ][b]Discord channel.[/b][/url]

Now, where can you experience all the amazing creations from the community? 

That’s right—we’ve partnered with Steam to launch our very own [i]Workshop alongside the Devkit![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/d484947eaedb2b5bae321a01f60891eea62db6a4.png[/img]
Just like other Steam Workshops, we’re committed to making sure you can upload and share all the content you create with fellow Soulmask players. Whether it’s a burly sailor or a metallic giraffe, let your imagination run wild!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/6f3fcb3372ac4bf145f87ab120d09619871722cb.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h3]One last thing...[/h3]

Lastly, let’s circle back to the most important question:
[b]What Mods do you want to see on the Steam Workshop?[/b]

The comments section is the best place to share your thoughts and ideas! Tell us what Mods you’re most excited to see, and who knows? Maybe our creators will find some inspiration from your suggestions!

And remember, the Workshop is just the beginning of what's coming in our big September update. We've got mysterious ancient battlefields with hidden treasures, cool new tech from upgraded masks... but we'll spill the beans on all that good stuff real soon.

This is Maggie signing off. Remember to share your feedback and ideas. Soulmask needs you to become even better! See you next time!

notes.title: PvP Server Season Reset Schedule: First Batch
notes.content:
Dear Chieftains:

After careful consideration and planning, we are announcing our plans to reset the PvP server season. The reset and data clearing will occur in batches based on the server opening times.
We understand that this decision will impact all PvP players, which is why we are notifying you one month in advance. Here is our explanation for this action plan and its benefits for players:

[Competitive Balancing and Fair Play]: The season reset ensures a fair competitive environment for all chieftains, allowing both new and experienced players to start each new season on equal footing and re-engage in the thrill of PvP battles.

[Server System Stability]: As more players continue to explore the world, game servers are nearing full capacity, negatively affecting gameplay. The season reset and data clearing will enhance server performance and reduce latency, ensuring a smoother experience in Soulmask.

[Updates to Improve PvP Fairness]: As Soulmask is still in early access, we are planning major updates with a focus on improving PvP gameplay. Clearing game data will provide a fresh start for all chieftains and will ultimately result in better PvP gameplay.

With the PvP server season reset underway, we will soon announce our new server plan. Details will be provided to all chieftains via the [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1tuc6Gbr9KLYdmPUIq9RfGiPPhpQyuYwjXZryQ2_1G-M/edit?gid=132555037#gid=132555037]server planning document[/url].

We believe that this season reset will offer a more stable, fair, and exciting gameplay experience in Soulmask, Your feedback is welcome to help us improve the game. Thank you for your understanding and support.

notes.title: Soulmask Early Access Regular Update 15
notes.content:
Dear Chieftains,

To provide a better gaming experience, the server will undergo maintenance. It will be temporarily unavailable starting from August 8, at 7:00 AM UTC, with an expected downtime of 30 minutes. This update includes a client update, and chieftains will need to update their client to enjoy the game normally. We are very grateful for your understanding and support.

The update details are as follows:

[h3][New Features and Adjustments][/h3]

A new top cover prompt has been added for Campfires and other buildings.
New rain sound effects have been added for Campfires, Bonfires, Torches, and Fire Pits.
A new standby sound effect has been added for Power Crafting Tables.
The production of the cloths necessary for crafting tribe gear has been increased.
When selecting HP recovery items at home, tribesmen will prioritize bandages over other instant recovery items.
The building comfort level prompt now displays the maximum number of same-type buildings that can be stacked.
When Parrot Rack are removed, parrots no longer die instantly.
Improved the auto-collection feature at Mines.
A dynamic difficulty switch has been added for boss or elite battles based on the number of players.
A visual effect indicating out-of-combat range has been added during boss and elite battles.
The default Stamina Recovery Speed coefficients in both Hard and Master difficulties have been reduced.
Water tanks and water buckets filled with water are now directly drinkable; tribesmen and mounts can also use them to replenish hydration.
New environmental sound effects have been added for regions such as Mangrove, Plateau, Wetland, Volcano, Desert, and Snow Mountain.
The volume of environmental sounds and background music is now automatically lowered in most full-screen interfaces.
Once mines reach their storage capacity, tribesmen will transfer the resources to nearby mine chests.
A new setting has been added to adjust the coefficient for mount summoning distance.
The chat function now has a 2-second cooldown and a limit of 300 characters per message.
Optimized the sitting animation.

[h3][Bug Fixes and Optimizations][/h3]

Fixed an issue affecting the appearance of hairstyles under specific circumstances.
Fixed an issue with certain trap constructions calculating the distance to others' as excessively far during placement.
Fixed an issue where the mammoth's right tusk did not contribute to comfort levels.
Fixed an issue where the beds in the barracks might not function correctly.
Fixed an issue preventing deployed tribesmen from using instant HP recovery items.
Fixed an issue where the Fang Tribe Leader's Poisonous Fog did not display the expected visuals.
Fixed an issue where fences and lighting buildings could be constructed around another one's base.
Fixed an issue with windows being unable to Retrieve and Repair.
Fixed an issue where tribesmen titled with the "Chest Breaker" failed to open chests normally.
Fixed an issue where some Stone buildings could stack with buildings made of other materials.
Fixed an issue where external environmental noises could be heard inside caverns.
Fixed an issue with characters being charged double Stamina for auto-running upon respawn.
Fixed the issue of over-bonus of shield proficiency increase granted by shield technique damages.
Fixed an issue where humanoid NPCs were unresponsive to ranged attacks in specific locations.
Fixed an issue where the overhead level indicator failed to refresh properly after a copied tribesman's first level-up.
Fixed an issue where the use of the Mysterious Bodyshaping Pill within a chest was ineffective.
Fixed an issue with summoned mounts not recovering Stamina in cross-server buildings.
Fixed an issue where bonuses were not reset after using Oblivion Soup.
Optimized the game stuttering issue caused by continuous use of the Butcher's Knife under low server frame rates.

notes.title: Soulmask FAST Q＆A 07: Thrill Seekers Event Special Episode
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, chieftains![/h2]

It's been almost two weeks since our first major update, and we hope you've been having a blast in the new Soulmask world!
We're still focused on addressing a series of issues that remain after this comprehensive improvement. For instance, last week, Laura hosted a "Thrill Seekers" event on our Discord channel (if you haven't joined our official Discord yet, what are you waiting for!). 

We're incredibly grateful for the community's enthusiasm, and we've received valuable feedback on this new version. As always, we particularly appreciate your suggestions for improvements, which we're already working to implement.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/288743c67e1972cd4dc2eeea84678f723bd3e7fb.jpg[/img]
Let's dive into ZIMA's responses to your feedback. All these improvements are in the pipeline and will be part of future updates![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[i]1. First, from Equivocus and xPh3n: [/i][b]The improvements are great and all, but has Soulmask gone a bit too soft? We're itching for more hardcore, brutal survival challenges![/b]

A: We're thrilled to hear from our hardcore players, and we're working on it! We're planning to roll out a batch of custom options soon, allowing players to better tailor the difficulty. This includes toggles for a series of modifications we've made in Early Access.

Additionally, we're planning to launch new [b]"Hardcore Mode" official servers[/b]. Still yearning for the most primitive Soulmask survival experience? You'll be able to feel the full pressure of this world again!

[i]2. From idiotica and Jestersuave: [/i][b]The Hitstun mechanic is wrecking the combat system - it's just too darn powerful![/b]

A: Trust us, we've heard this one a few times! We've been scratching our heads trying to figure out how to balance this without going from one extreme to another. Finding the sweet spot between Parry Hitstun and Empty Resilience Hitstun benefits is like trying to walk a tightrope - it needs some careful thinking.

That's why in last week's update, we made some changes on both the Active and Passive aspects. On the Active side, we added a new active skill called [b]"Recover Sense."[/b] It's a long-CD ability that lets you break free from controlled states like Parry Hitstun and Empty Resilience Hitstun, giving you at least one chance to turn the tables when you're on the back foot.

We're also tweaking the Hitstun mechanic itself: When a Chieftain is caught in a Hitstun, [b]each hit they take now reduces the Hitstun duration[/b]. This maintains the control aspect of Hitstun without leading to excessive damage.

[i]3. from theothergaia:[/i][b] Boss health scales with the number of participants, including tribesmen followers! This makes our loyal companions more of a liability than an asset in Boss fights![/b]

A: To clarify, the Boss stat scaling does have a cap - it maxes out at 10 participants. We totally get that in solo play, you don't want your tribesmen to accidentally crank up the difficulty. So, we're thinking of adding a toggle for[b] "Boss health scaling" in the custom settings.[/b]

Down the road, we might even refine this system further. For example, a Chieftain + tribesmen team might cause less of a Boss health bump compared to a full player party. We'll keep you posted when we nail down the final plan.

[i]4. From Battch and Battz ツ: [/i][b]The "Steel Body" ability is overpowered, especially when combined with hammers, dominating PVP.[/b]

A: We hear you. That's why our recent update introduced a [b]new bow skill called "Eclipse."[/b] It fires a black arrow that temporarily nullifies all Superarmor effects in the area. This should make Chieftains think twice before spamming "Steel Body" and other Superarmor effects.

[i]5. From ごえもぉん:[/i][b] Any chance we could get a better way to manage our mounts?[/b]

A: We know everyone's tired of juggling their animal companions and livestock in the same messy pile. Good news - we're working on a shiny new animal management system, coming your way soon! We're also throwing in some custom sliders for mount limits and other tweaks.

But that's not all, folks! We're also beefing up the mount recall system. Soon, you'll be able to[b] summon your trusty steed from up to 100 meters away[/b]. No more losing your ride in the wilderness!

[i]6.Both DOSorDIE and Jestersuave have repeatedly expressed this hope: [/i][b]More custom options![/b]

A:As you might have noticed from our previous answers, we're big on customization. As a sandbox survival game, we prioritize tailored experiences for both single-player and private servers. Rest assured, more custom options are on the way, [b]including adjustable drop level, boss damage coefficients, and more![/b]

[i]7. Jengster raised a concern about[/i][b] our PVP official servers heading south and dying out too quickly.[/b]

A: We've noticed this trend and believe it's time to discuss implementing a season function for PVP servers. Don't worry - we'll approach this carefully and give you plenty of options. We'll dive into the details soon, aiming for a solution that keeps everyone happy. And yes, a seasonal race for PvP servers will be our direaction going forward.

Additionally, as one of our most important gameplay aspects, we plan to make plenty of experimental trials on PvP servers, including more diverse gameplay and mechanics of PvP season. Keep an eye out for more future updates!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
Chieftains, your passion for the new version of Soulmask is truly inspiring. While we couldn't address every issue here, know that we're constantly working on improvements. (For a taste of what's to come, check out yesterday's patch - our tribesmen are now civilized enough to close the door behind them after using the Outhouse!)

Stay tuned for more update previews coming soon. Until next time, Chieftains!

[b]Community Manager Peter
Lead Producer ZIMA[/b]

[b]Join discord: [url=https://discord.com/invite/4G2K7FDbtp]https://discord.com/invite/4G2K7FDbtp[/url]
[/b]

notes.title: Soulmask Official Server Fair Operation Notice
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Chieftains,[/h2]

In this virtual world, we believe what we're after is joy and challenges instead of argument and fight. So we sincerely call upon all players to try their best to maintain a wholesome and friendly game environment together.

Any and all cheat codes, third-party tools, and other forms of cheating are not tolerated in the game. After confirmation, the cheating account will be forever banned and revealed in the community. We also encourage you to report to us via the Report interface and cleanse the game environment.
Soulmask values the fairness in the game and would do anything to maintain it. Our operation team will vet these illegal behaviors and take measures accordingly [b]only to official servers[/b]. Should any player be found misbehaving, we'd have to resort to Warning, Mute, and even Account Ban, all in an attempt to protect the players' interest and ensure that every player can enjoy a fair and positive game.　　Thanks for your support and understanding!

[b][h3]Behaviors that cause your game account to be banned:[/h3][/b]
[olist]
[*] Any modification or testing of the game client, including but not limited to decompiling programs, packet spoofing, and damaging the game client.
[*] The use of any third-party software, including but not limited to cheat codes, modifiers, scripts, and attachments.
[*] Use DDOS Attack or other technical means to obtain in-game interests.
[*] Exploit game bugs and procedure loopholes to gain interests, to disturb the gaming order, or to achieve personal purposes that cause loss to other players.
[/olist]

[b][h3]Behaviors that cause your game account to be muted:[/h3][/b]
[olist]
[*] Send words to pose officials, GMs, or administrators.
[*] Post abusive, threatening, harassing, obscene, pornographic, hate speech, defamatory, or otherwise offensive comments.
[*] Negative comments on religion, international politics, terrorism, nationalism, racial discrimination, or other sensitive topics.
[*] Post ads, external links, and other content unrelated to the game.
[*] Talk about using illegal means or exploiting game loopholes to undermine fair gaming.
[/olist]

[b][h3]Behaviors that cause your in-game buildings to be demolished:[/h3][/b]
[olist]
[*] Use bugs to build your base inside a mountain, underwater, on the map edge, or at other places. 
[*] Erect unauthorized building shapes.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[b][h3]FAQs:[/h3][/b]

[b]Q: Where can I report the bad behaviors of other players?[/b]

A: If you find inappropriate or illegal behaviors, you can use the in-game report page or inform our staff in the community. We'll give it due punishment to cleanse the game environment.
[b]Q: Is it possible to unblock my account after lending it to someone else whose behavior resulted in a ban?[/b]

A: No. The subject of our punishments is accounts, not individuals. Besides, the account's bad behaviors have ruined other players' experience and should be punished. We hereby remind players that do not share your account with others to avoid other losses.

[b]Q: Why was I punished? I didn't use any modifier or cheat software.[/b]

A: Soulmask assumes a zero-tolerance attitude toward cheating of any sort. Installing cheating software and using or try using illegal third-party software are all illegal and may lead to an account ban. If there is a cheater in your tribe and other members obtain interests via this cheater, directly or indirectly, it may cause the entire tribe to be banned, the level of which depends on how bad the influence it has caused. The final explanation of this goes to the official team of Soulmask.

[b]Q: I was punished for no reason, how do I appeal?[/b]

A: Our team will go through vigorous checks before giving punishments to prevent mistakes. If you're not convinced, please inform our staff in the community. We'll process your appeal.

[b]Q: How do I appeal when I find illegal behaviors on a private server?[/b]

A: Soulmask values the fairness in the game and cracks down on illegal behaviors on the official server currently, but we've also passed the account ban directive to private server creators. If you find illegal behaviors on a private server, we suggest you contact the private server creator to deal with this. 
[b]How to ban players on the private server?[/b]
[list]
[*] Execute the GM command: AddServerPermissionList 1 steamID(e.g. 76561************)
[/list]
[b]How to unblock players on the private server?[/b]
[list]
[*] Execute the GM command: RemoveServerPermissionList 1 steamID(e.g. 76561************)
[/list]
[b]How to mute players on the private server?[/b]
[list]
[*] Execute the GM command:  AddServerPermissionList 4 steamID(e.g. 76561************)
[/list]
[b]How to unmute players on the private server?[/b]
[list]
[*] Execute the GM command:  RemoveServerPermissionList 4 steamID(e.g. 76561************)problems on a private server, please contact its creator.
[/list]
[b]Q: Why can't I log in to online mode with my family-sharing account?[/b]

A: All players who are using the Steam Family Sharing function, please note that we enabled this function to let the game owner share the game with another Steam user more conveniently.  But we also noticed that some cheaters were exploiting this mechanism. To foster a nice gaming environment, we've decided to suspend this function on the official server. Your understanding will be appreciated.

notes.title: Soulmask Early Access Regular Update 14
notes.content:
Dear Chieftains,

To provide a better gaming experience, the server will undergo maintenance. It will be temporarily unavailable starting from August 1, at 7:00 AM UTC, with an expected downtime of 30 minutes. This update includes a client update, and chieftains will need to update their client to enjoy the game normally. We are very grateful for your understanding and support.

The update details are as follows:

[h3][New Features and Adjustments][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added "Gestures" system, accessible by pressing the "H" key (by default)
[*] When tribesmen caring for bonfires are overloaded or have less backpack capacity, fuel will be directly moved to the bonfire fuel slot from chests that contain fuel
[*] The effects of Poisonous Arrows can be immunized by dodging
[*] Added an action for using Oblivion Soup; the proficiency of tribesmen can be reset directly
[*] Life Perception can now detect monuments and chests
[*] When enabled, the Lighting Module enhances the ability of Life Perception to detect and find humanoid creatures' titles
[*] Added Lighting Module toggle
[*] Tribesmen will close the door behind them after using the Outhouse
[*] When transferring preferred items to other inventories, their preference settings will be persisted by default
[*] Preference settings of items in the death package will be persisted
[*] When there's a stalled task lining up in multiple crafting queues, the continuable tasks will be prioritized upon current completion at the top of the crafting queues
[*] "Fatal Rhythm" talent updated;  attacking enemies will receive a bonus while maintaining Stamina between 60%-90%
[/list]

[h3][Bug Fixes and Optimizations][/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where the name and remarks of the initial character were not saved after revival
[*] Fixed the mismatch between the arrow release position and animation when NPC uses certain bow skills
[*] Fixed the issue where blood would spew during the invincibility frames of a successful dodge
[*] Fixed the issue where damage numbers do not appear upon hitting enemy with Backstab using Gauntlets
[*] Fixed the issue where the Feed Trough cannot be repaired
[*] Fixed the incorrect size of Ostrich hatched from an Ostrich egg
[*] Fixed the issue where Chests cannot be opened if disconnected during the process of opening a Chest

[*] Optimized the spawn height of elite Horned Eagles and elite Vultures
[*] Optimized Central Core combat effects
[/list]

notes.title: Soulmask Chieftains' Stories Episode 2: BeastMama
notes.content:
[b][h3]Hi Chieftains![/h3][/b]

Welcome to a new episode of Soulmask Player Stories! Since the release date of Soulmask, we have met many Chieftains with enthusiasm and charm, their support and love for Soulmask have added a vibrant touch to our community. Their enthusiasm has inspired us to share their stories of encountering Soulmask with everyone.

This time, our protagonist is a volunteer that every player in the Soulmask Discord community knows well: Beastmama. As one of the first community volunteers for Soulmask, her passion for the game and the player community is truly remarkable—as Maggie would say, just like a mama!

So, we are excited to share her story with Soulmask and, of course, her enthusiasm for the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/76f5f8713a7744ff33ae8020a5063bc39060d676.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[b]So first, Do you mind to introduce yourself a little? [/b]

[i]So pretty much I am BeastMama, I embraced my online game name many years ago because of my love for animals even if they are pixel animals.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/3ce9f4683056a6926822ab49ed003fa64da3f610.png[/img]
[i]I am a 37 years old and help my family run their business and i pretty much play online games in my spare time, which is not much to be fair since job, family and studies takes up most of it[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/bf9754e0b5b977f0c7c53ceff9e1b5219e4bc797.jpg[/img]
[b][i]Mama's lovely beasties.[/i][/b]

[i]I am always in discord though xD - I am very passionate about what i love. (Soulmask is right up top in there ;D ) And i am extremely protective of my friends and people around me in general![/i]

[b]So where did you find out about Soulmask? What were your first impressions of it? As a survival game, you know.[/b]

[i]I am part of a big gaming community - Pirate Gaming. In that community we all share games with each other and One of them pointed me to Soulmask. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/aa3b8d57757a86cce0ca40b6661898599b1e549d.jpg[/img]
My very first impressions of the game was like…[b]Why I cannot log out of it?[/b] It felt refreshing, Felt Unique and innovative. And the more time I spent online and in the discord community the more I just couldnt get enough.[/i]

[b]Seriously, Mama, we are very impressed with your love for the Soulmask lol, what elements led you to love it so much?[/b]

[i]The combat, the skill variety, the npc system, and i love that you are not fully attached to 1 character. You can just jump around and be a completely different person everyday.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/6592fefec819ca772b876bc7bc129654cb5557ed.png[/img]
The mask system is so unique and new. Every single survival I play is, go here, gather this, obtain this other thing, level, craft, wear this new equipment, and become powerful

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/1269b6e257e289e845453aa12d0ace47c2708c75.png[/img]
Soulmask added a whole new layer to it with the Mask system and the tribesmen! [/i]

[b]Are there any moments in Soulmask that stick with you?[/b]

[i]first and most was the first time i tamed a Leopard. It was Danneh the leopard. he is forever one of the best stickers in discord.
 
When i saw that beautiful face...i think i was laughing for 10 minutes none stop! the devs really done it with those leopard faces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/74c8e15ee5e8f840882101333c7d98c25a399e29.gif[/img]
The second, was finding the first Ancient Dungeon. I swear I did not expect to find that type of Content in a tribal survival map, the feeling of wonder and surprise

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/052831aba27f863f0715473c18e0b22bf0b21d99.png[/img]
Also xD when we saw the volcano was actually a part of the map you could explore, we first spent a few hours just jumping down thru the crater hahaha like idiots[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/f9441085b20a10934db4319577bd92acd474dbcb.gif[/img]

[b]Let's go back to the community: you are now our NUMBER ONE volunteer: so many players in the community have been helped by you![/b]

[i]At first, I felt needed by other players. I am a very experience gamer (perks of getting old) xD So i tend to learn things and advance quickly. I enjoy helping others and I noticed that the learning curve of this game could use some help until the tutorials got fully developed, Which they did. 

And now I feel attached to the community. I feel responsible for it (even if I do not have to) Many of the players that we have in the discord deserve to be cared for and loved. and If I can do anything in my power to help, You bet I will be there to help them

I honestly couldn't have done it with all other volunteers and many other very helpful members of our community[/i]

[b]Mama, In your community volunteer work, What do you find most interesting in the Soulmask community? [/b]

[i]I love how we have created an environment together that players feel safe and trust to spend time in it. Some players even went as far as creating gifs and pictures of ingame content. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/adae5f22b09a5f4938a39fde1110a61f14241f97.gif[/img]
After having to answer that question 9000000 million times before release date....[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/b743270c14982c0e70292ab3fb906c73e9b9bda0.gif[/img]

[b]THATS TOUGH lol. Last question: What do you wanna say to the newbie in the Soulmask?[/b]

[i]To pve players, The Game is HUGE, the options are vast and You do not have to know everything by day one. Enjoy the ride and If you get lost and Do not know where to go or how to do something, Tag me, beastmama is here for you, or any of our incredible volunteers, We will happily help you.

To the pvp Players, The game is not perfect, But Devs are working on it day and night Tirelessly. Make sure You do drop your Suggestions in our discord, They are eager to listen to the player base. 

And for the love of everything sacred ... Check the PINS!! [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/037785380343206b28cd44bb66ba9a16cd3dc97c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
In the future, we will introduce more special Soulmask Chieftains like Mama, including ANYONE! But we believe that regardless of the titles they have, they all possess a commonality: the boundless love for Soulmask, just like all of you!

[b]Maggie[/b]

notes.title: Soulmask Early Access Regular Update 13
notes.content:
Dear Chieftains,

To provide a better gaming experience, the server will undergo maintenance. It will be temporarily unavailable starting from July 25, at 7:00 AM UTC, with an expected downtime of 30 minutes. This update includes a client update, and chieftains will need to update their client to enjoy the game normally. We are very grateful for your understanding and support.

The update details are as follows:

[h3][New Features and Adjustments][/h3]

New bow skill added: "Eclipse" - Shoots a black arrow that nullifies most Superarmor effects and talents of the target and the adjacent enemies (Superarmor talents affected include: "Hardened Body", "Firm Will", "Steel Body").

While a player character is in a "Parry Hitstun" or "Empty Resilience Hitstun" state, each attack received shortens the Hitstun duration, until the Hitstun state ends.

After unlocking the "Core Functional Module" Soulmask node, a new skill is added: "Recover Sense", which can be used during "Parry Hitstun" or "Empty Resilience Hitstun", or when executed to regain control of the character.

Added Half-Height parts for thatch and wooden buildings.

Added Left Sloping Wall parts for thatch, stone, and blackstone buildings.

Improved Life Perception with the activation of Lighting Module. Allows for detection of quality of creatures.

Added coefficient manager switch: Interaction Limit for Damaged Buildings - Damaged buildings are unable to be repaired or relocated for a duration of time by default.

Coefficient settings now allow toggling on/off building number limits within an area.

Coefficient settings now support adjustment of tribe population.

Added prompts to notify of invalid Arena challenges, along with an Arena log.

Removed rule prohibiting tribesmen from using the Enhanced Tools when gathering materials.

Class skill "Unyielding Determination" now has a cooldown of 45 seconds (previously 60 seconds).
Added Oblivion Soup, which resets the proficiency nodes.

Clan interface is now sorted by tribesman names.

Constructing a Piranha Pond no longer requires an upgraded Building Workshop.

Using shield skills to deal damage now awards Shield Proficiency EXP.

Removed "Dismantle" option from the mining platform. It can now be repaired normally.

[h3][Bug Fixes][/h3]

Fixed the issue where animals summoned by Nature Enlightenment would not follow your character in certain conditions.

Fixed the issue where scene loading could encounter an error while creating characters in online mode.

Fixed the issue causing Slime Can and Fecal Tank to still inflict negative effects when dodged through rolling.

Fixed the abnormal behavior occurring from feeding multiple liquor bottles to deterred NPCs.

Fixed the issue where screen effects persist when controlling other tribesmen in a drunk state.

Fixed a potential crash issue when returning to the main menu and then continuing in single-player mode.

Fixed the issue of incorrectly displayed material quantities in crafting blueprint tips.

Fixed the issue where material would be taken from someone else's locked chest when performing crafting and sourcing material automatically.

Fixed the issue of getting stuck on the edge of a valve trap.

Fixed the issue where the quantity of animals did not decrease after transferring them to others.

Fixed the issue of not being able to use items after entering Near-death state while drawing a bow.

Fixed the issue where class abilities might become abnormal following multiple data copies.

Fixed the issue of being able to stand on anti-climb thorns in certain conditions.

Fixed climbability issues with sticky combustion cans, sticky explosive cans, and advanced sticky explosive cans.

Fixed the issue where NPCs would throw slime cans, fecal tanks, and grease tanks endlessly.

Fixed the issues of the character getting stuck by certain branches, buildings, and gaps within scenes.

notes.title: Major Update #1: Evolution of Masks
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/656ea308fe40c8c23616a0cab265cac83e078212.jpg[/img]
The moment you've been waiting for has arrived! Soulmask proudly presents its major update, "Evolution of Masks," available starting today. We hope the wait hasn't been too long. As your adventure progresses, the enigmatic masks from the mysterious civilization continue to evolve. What new surprises lie ahead on your journey?

[b]The update will automatically download to your game![/b]

[i][b]Meanwhile, a limited-time 10% off of Soulmask will be offered on steam store to celebrate our first major update of Soulmask![/b][/i]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2646460/announcements/detail/4337612994956066585][b][h3]You can click here for detailed update content[/h3][/b][/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h3]Quick Remodel[/h3]

[b][i]In dire situations, just before a mask wearer's demise, the mask will now teleport their body and consciousness back to the Bonfire, remodeling them using logged data.[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/cceabab8cbc70b6f419d00748bf1e34faf6d42fe.gif[/img]
In this new version, after defeating the Vajra Ape, you can unlock a new mask feature: [i][b]Quick Remodel.[/b][/i] 

Any body controlled by the mask, whether it's the Chief or the tribesmen, can be quickly revived at the Respawn Point/Campfire. However, this teleportation and quick repair cause a debuff due to energy loss, affecting Max HP and Recovery ability of the revived body.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/69b22e4a03dbfbb4d781895d6760c27d3ba18e47.png[/img]
You can still use the Mysterious Stone Table for traditional remodeling. While this method requires more time and resources, it grants new buff to your resurrected tribesmen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/8d5c664589b3e99b67cb8d4838121a0a6c68be4e.png[/img]

[b]Important notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Tribesmen must be entered at the Mysterious Stone Table to be eligible for Quick Remodel.
[*] When resurrecting tribesmen, their stats revert to the last entered data in the Mysterious Stone Table.
[/list]
This is just a glimpse of the mask's new potential... The Chieftain's body has also undergone significant changes...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h3]Chieftain's Enhancement[/h3]

[b][i]As your bond with the mask deepens, your once-fragile body grows stronger.[/i][/b]

In the new version, we've enhanced the starter character's basic abilities for a smoother early game experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/92c78351095c043740e6edef0108d670025b488e.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Level cap increased from 40 to 50.
[*] Production proficiency cap increased from 50 to 60, and combat proficiency cap from 50 to 90.
[*] Basic stats upgraded to the level of blue-tier barbarians.
[*] As you level up the starter character, unlock these unique talents:
[/list]
[b]Tribe - Survivor: [/b]As a survivor of the tribe wars, you'll need strength to survive in this land. Max Load +20%.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/70abd6823df1e07833250a44bc9d49d4884f9889.jpg[/img]
[b]Nimble Movement: [/b]I'm always a step ahead of death. Movement Speed +5%.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/3592d432df56c1f063d0fb761d6b5ef81a50bf1b.png[/img]
[b]Strong Physique: [/b]This body has endured so much. Max Stamina +20.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/3592d432df56c1f063d0fb761d6b5ef81a50bf1b.png[/img]
[b]Crisis Response: [/b]When attacked, has a 20% chance to increase DEF and Max HP by 5% each for 30 seconds. (CD: 50s)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/7719698124aa68c1cbcbebb5e24ac37bd34cf8d8.png[/img]
[b]Desperate Struggle: [/b]Recovers 15% of HP in 5 seconds when HP is below 15%. (CD: 35s)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/69558368a7de53133a3942837a05bb030b557b95.png[/img]
[b]Critical Counter:[/b]Gains a 5% damage boost for 6 seconds after blocking an enemy attack. (CD: 15s)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/a337f2251ca785e90c6806dee0eb446728c582b9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h3]Data Copying[/h3]

[i][b]By harnessing the extensive genetic data recorded from the tribesmen, the Chief's original body can undergo a complete transformation and enhancement, ultimately acquiring all the abilities possessed by the tribesmen.[/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/047407a85e533e6b5b372ad8b093a856ded1f17f.gif[/img]
In the new version, by spending mask energy and crystals, we can conduct deep genetic scans of specific tribesmen and modify the Chief's body accordingly, copying all abilities of specific tribesmen to the starter character.

After defeating the Vajra Ape and unlocking the third mask node, Chiefs can choose the tribesmen for info entry in the "Remodel" module of the Mysterious Stone Table and start deep genetic scanning.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/2f799032cc0f34725515792d55953b760102e339.jpg[/img]
After scanning for a while, their biological information can be transferred to the starter character.

Please note that once logged info is replaced, the Mysterious Stone Table cannot process similar genetic information again. Therefore, [b]body data copy is irreversible, and the copied tribesmen cannot undergo genetic logging again.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/6f65e392d4496494f96d2eb028e13d4089b1992e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h3]Tribesmen Squad[/h3]

[i][b]A single follower is no longer sufficient for the increasingly intense battles. Our tribesmen have been trained in team combat tactics using the mask's data.[/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/8c2b58bfb1b58ad6d458621a9717d52e4cc95e82.jpg[/img]
In the new version, we introduce the mechanism for multiple tribesmen to join battles in Solo/LAN/private server modes. You can adjust the Max number of participating tribesmen in the advanced settings (default is 3).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/6e668bb868230f45cc6fae0f8c97b8f73f3939b1.gif[/img]
Interact with multiple tribesmen directly or open the "Clan" page for batch deployment. They will execute the Chiefs' commands uniformly.

[b]Important notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Due to server load considerations, the official server does not support multiple tribesmen in battle.
[*] For solo games, consider balancing difficulty settings with your tribesmen squad size for the best experience.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h3]Craft from inventory[/h3]

[i][b]The enigmatic mask continues to reveal its mysterious powers. Recently, chiefs discovered that the mask can teleport raw materials needed for production from storage boxes to the workbench through spatial teleportation technology.[/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/c0cb49d3aca775a898a29e0dd22fbd9540fdb52a.jpg[/img]
In this update, we introduce the global resource calling function. Toggle the "Automatically call box resources when crafting" option in the advanced settings to use this function.

When crafting, Chiefs or mask-controlled tribemen can efficiently use materials from all boxes within the campfire range at any workbench.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h3]More Updates You Want:[/h3]

[b][list]
[*] Forget portal node unlock restrictions! Once you obtain the portal, you can use it immediately!
[*] You can now use self-crafted portals to teleport materials and animals on official and private servers.
[*] New resurrection rooms have been added to the ruins dungeons and holy ruins. However, you will need to activate them first.
[*] In solo/private server mode, you can customize the AI difficulty levels, bringing different AI combat strategy changes.
[*] We made roof construction more logical: triangular sloped roofs can now be built on sloped roofs, and triangular sloped roofs can be built around the foundation.
[*] Mammoth specimens now have tusks on the other side! We know this bothered you!
[*] We fixed the endless throwing items of the barbarians for fair combat!
[/list][/b]
...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
For the complete changelog, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2646460/announcements/detail/4337612994956066585]click here[/url]. But why read when you could be playing? Dive into the new Soulmask experience now!

[b]And a special event regarding the key points of this update is being held in our Discord community! Want to share your feelings with our chief producer ZIMA? [url=https://discord.com/channels/1160486185840418927/1160537278456791052/1263396720931377275]Click and join the event![/url][/b]

[b]Community Manager Maggie
Lead Producer ZIMA[/b]

[b]Join discord: [url=https://discord.com/invite/4G2K7FDbtp]https://discord.com/invite/4G2K7FDbtp[/url]
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/64b7d63f8ff2b42a33514fe3574d43861d46430a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Soulmask Early Access Regular Update 12
notes.content:
Dear Chieftains,

To provide a better gaming experience, the server will undergo maintenance. It will be temporarily unavailable starting from July 18, at 7:00 AM UTC, with an expected downtime of 30 minutes. This update includes a client update, and chieftains will need to update their client to enjoy the game normally. We are very grateful for your understanding and support.

The update details are as follows:

[h3][Gameplay and Function Adjustments][/h3]

Data Update-3 Adjustment: Defeating Vajra Ape unlocks the Data Copy tech and the Quick Remodel function now instead of Portal. Can copy a tribesman's quality, level, class, title, talent, proficiency, mastery, and so on, and transfer these data to the initial character. The recorded tribesmen can also be revived at Bonfire/Campfire/Respawn Point.
Perfect Remodel has unlocked on the official server. Perfect revival is available now to tribesmen with recorded data. Please update the tribesman data timely.
Production proficiency cap for initial characters has changed to 60 from 50; battle proficiency cap has changed to 90 from 50. Besides, Body Enhance 3 at Mask Node removed the bonus on the initial character's proficiency.
The initial character's level cap has changed to Lv.50 from Lv.40.
The initial character's aptitude has improved. It can get exclusive talents as it levels up.
Added more portals in various scenes.
The portal in a scene can be connected to the portal built by players (except for in the PVP Server).
PVE on the official server enables teleporting with supplies and animals through self-built portals by default.
Portal can be used once acquired. The node limit has been removed.
Added new Respawn Point Room in Ruins Dungeon and Holy Ruins (needs activation)
When crafting items at Crafting Table, you will auto-use the materials in the chests nearby.
Added "Deployed Tribesmen" Coefficient. Set this coefficient to deploy multiple tribesmen. This coefficient is set at 3 on Solo/Private Server by default. You can change it later. The coefficient on the Official Server is still 1.
Raised the coefficient of "Max Number of Personal Marks" and "Max Number of Shared Marks". They can both reach 100 marks now.
Can customize AI Level on Solo/Private Server
Can transfer animals to others.
Added the fang on the other side of the Mammoth Specimen.（Press Z to switch)
Walls or city walls can't be built if creatures are in the way.
Buildings within the range of someone else's bonfire can't be replaced or upgraded.
Tempest Griffin's feathers can be used to craft Steel Arrow.
Increased Poisonous Arrow's Poison DMG.
Updated the appearance of some elite animals.
Added new General Talent Affixes: "Crisis Resolution", "Quick Bandaging", and "Quick Reload".
Added the new exclusive affix "Desperate Response" for Fang Tribe.
The target of the title "Axe Killer" takes 10% more DMG instead of 8% now.
The Nighttime Movement Speed granted by the title "Nightwalker" changes to 10% from 5%.
Increased the Bleeding DMG inflicted by the title "Fly Cutter Assassin" on the target.
The Stamina Recovery Reduction inflicted by the title "Lung Piercer" on the target changes to 80% from 50%.
The duration of the Slow triggered by the title "Archery Master" changes to 6s from 5s.
The DMG inflicted by the title "Butcher In Woods" on animals changes to 10% from 5%.
The duration of the triggered effect of the title "Death Bringer" extends to 8s.
The DMG Increase on Torso granted by the title "Heartcaptor" changes to 12% from 10%.
Talent affixes "Enemy Down Fervency", "Slaughter Fervency", and "Wrath of Revenge" can be triggered by both Near-death and Death now.
Can stack up more arrows now, and the weight has reduced. You can carry them through self-built portals.
Can build Gable Roof on the Pitched Roof.
Can build Gable Roof around Foundation.
Auto-enable the Account Ban and Mute functions when starting the server.
Official PVE servers will have player-built portal material transport and animal teleportation enabled by default.

[h3][Bug Fixes][/h3]

Fixed the issue that Mysterious Stone Table can be moved when remodeling.
Fixed the occasional hairstyle anomaly when displaying the mask in Mimicry.
Fixed the special effect remnant issue of some mimicry effects.
Fixed the issue that players could still interact with tribesmen and mount after death.
Fixed the issue of medium traps that in some cases, the animal wouldn't enter the cage.
Fixed the issue that the proficiency effect didn't take effect when tribesmen were planting.
Fixed the issue that target sent flying by Thrust Strike (Great Sword Mastery) would fall down earlier than it should.
Fixed the issue that there was no difference between the "Malice" icons of the three different levels.
Fixed the issue that the animal summoned by Nature Enlightenment still existed after the mask was switched.
Fixed the incoherent Brewing Tank naming.
Fixed the issue that durability of Exploiting Platform at the mine wouldn't be deducted.
Fixed the discrepancy between the actually deducted value and the deducted value displayed in Tips.
Fixed the issue that tribesmen joined after the first bonfire was built had no mastery skills.
Fixed the issue that bandages can be used during movement.
Fixed the issue that the food settings in Pen didn't take effect.
Optimized the light of Lighting Module.
Optimized the issue that barbarians could use throwable cans without quantity limit.
Optimized the construction model of some roofs.
Optimized the skill and combat AI of advanced mechanical monsters.

notes.title: Developer's Update: Soulmask—The Past 30 Days and the Future
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, chieftains:[/h2]

This is Maggie, your community manager. Since the launch of Early Access, our team has been on an incredible journey. We've been working tirelessly to address your feedback and elevate Soulmask to new heights. As we mentioned before EA, every member of our community plays a crucial role in shape this gaming universe.

I have to say, insisting on polishing our game and showcasing the peculiarities of Soulmask are always the belief of us as developers. Meanwhile, we are making all effort to enhance the experience for you, allowing people to explore Soulmask world more freely while sticking to their routines. Achieving both of these goals has never been an easy task,  but each of us believes that as a long-term project, Soulmask can only get better and better.

Today, we're excited to share a recap of our progress over the past month and unveil some game-changing [b]updates coming your way next month[/b]. Plus, we'll address some ongoing issues.

Ready? Let’s dive in!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[b][h2]30-Day Review[/h2][/b]

In the past 30 days, we have made nearly [b]600 [/b]modifications based on the feedback from chieftains. This includes enhancements of game experiecne, and adjustments to some game mechanics according to your suggestions while still maintaining the integrity of the world lore! Most importantly, making Soulmask even more "sandbox-like" with more custom options.

Here are the highlights:

[b][h3]Perfect Remodel for Tribesmen[/h3][/b]
This was your top concern in the first two weeks of EA, and we acted swiftly:

In the latest update of Soulmask, we've added a "Perfect Remodel" feature to the advanced settings for both single-player and private servers. This feature acts like a "tribesmen save file," allowing you to store and update all tribesmen data on the Mysterious Stone Table. When resurrected, your tribesmen will return with their most [b]recently saved data![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/ad358a9701a5caf767caae52d71d71253d3f516f.gif[/img]
We've also introduced an option that allows you to adjust the[b] cap on savable tribesmen[/b], giving you more freedom to preserve your favorite tribesmen.

We hope these enhancements will boost your confidence in sending your best tribesmen on daring adventures. And good news—we're planning to roll out Perfect Remodel on official servers soon!

[b][h3]Map Teleport Optimization[/h3][/b]
Maggie vividly remembers that in the first week of release, Soulmask was dubbed a "walking simulator" by the community, due to the extensive travel times caused by exploration and death.

We can't rely on campfires that can be extinguished by rain to solve all problems, so we've decided to take action. For instance, we've added new portals in all Pyramid and Holy Ruins areas, increasing the total n[b]umber of portals in Soulmask to 13[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/4c4c026806a06d2b4eb48f8716fffc68f39f7dca.jpg[/img]
We've also enhanced the practicality of player-crafted portals. These portals are now [b]unlocked much earlier in the game[/b], and we've added a single-player option that allows you to [b]carry materials through portals[/b]. More importantly, your followers will now accompany you for quick travel via portals.

Lastly, we've added [b]many new respawn points[/b] in mid-to-high-level areas. These points can be accessed by clearing the Fog of War, making exploration in these advanced areas significantly safer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/846c05b5f7bfc5a2705b2a4a3770c3184bc2a058.jpg[/img]
[b][h3]More Customization Options[/h3][/b]
One of the most frequently mentioned issues by players during the first month of EA was the lack of custom features. Addressing this has been one of our main priorities since then. If you're a player who loves personalized gaming experiences, you'll be excited to know that Soulmask now offers even more options in its advanced settings:

[list]
[*] We have introduced a switch to prevent enemies from respawning in barbarian camps when players are present—useful for PVE servers.
[*] We have introduced new options to adjust the crafting limits for bonfires and portals, and increased the limit on official servers to 10. This update offers greater flexibility in selecting your base locations.
[*] We now support the adjustment of load coefficient, allowing you to carry more ore.
[*] We have introduced an option to enable unlimited building height, allowing you to construct skyscrapers even with thatch. However, be cautious! Re-enabling the height limit will cause these towering structures to collapse!
[*] We've introduced an option to adjust the morale cost for tribesmen, so they won’t need sleep if you prefer.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/67f47ed438ed79ff189646f81db3876795907771.png[/img]
Of course the above isn't not all. For Soulmask, freedom isn't just reflected within the game world; we will continue to enrich the custom options to fulfill everyone's diverse needs. Therefore, we sincerely welcome every chieftain to provide more specific feedback on your needs.

[b][h3]Difficulty Curve Improvement[/h3][/b]
In our first month, we have been primarily focused on optimizing game difficulty and late-stage statistics. We hope to delve into the intricacies of stat design in future discussions. Our current optimization efforts are concentrated in the following areas:

[list]
[*] Adjusted the [b]late-game difficulty curve[/b], particularly in the snow mountain and volcano regions
[*] Enhanced various difficulty mechanics to improve gameplay balance. Notably, we have [b]removed monsters from dungeon entrances[/b] to increase player survival rates during exploration. Additionally, we've reduced the lethality of diseases and plagues, particularly for tribesmen.
[*] Increased the output of key materials, including [b]higher multiplier for BOSS and elite monster drops in multiplayer battles[/b]. Also, we've boosted the yield of essential items such as rubber and adhesive to support technological development.
[*] Shortened the stamina recovery time from 2 seconds to 0.5 seconds and made humanoid enemies use defense more than dodge for ranged attacks.
[/list]
[b][h3]Optimization for Tribesmen Followers:[/h3][/b]
Tribesmen are core to Soulmask. Over the past month, we’ve re-evaluated their roles and found many areas for enhancement:

For instance, when acting as followers, their survivability and support to the leader were lacking. To address this, we have improved their combat AI and increased their attack aggressiveness. In assist mode, they can now proactively engage in combats. Additionally, we've enhanced the overall survivability of all tribesmen; after being knocked down, they can quickly enter a feigned death state to recover. During this recovery period, enemies will no longer perceive them as threats—making them more valuable allies in battle.

We have also enhanced their functionality, allowing them to cultivate crops more intelligently. Additionally, we have improved their pathfinding capabilities: when an error occurs in the path, they can make slight adjustments using the mysterious power of the mask.

[b][h3]More Official Server Support[/h3][/b]
We strive to deliver unique experiences on our official servers. In the first month of Early Access, we introduced cross-server functionality for Asian, North American, and European PvP servers. Players can challenge different worlds through pyramid portals and defend against invaders!

We’ve also launched official servers in South America and Oceania, responding to feedback from Chiefs in those regions. Whether you prefer PVE or PVP, you can now play on a server in your area!We’ve also launched official servers in South America and Oceania, responding to feedback from Chiefs in those regions. Whether you prefer PVE or PVP, you can now play on a server in your area,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[b][h2]Updates for the Next Month[/h2][/b]
In our first month, we made significant progress, though it often felt like we were correcting mistakes on an imperfect test. But ZIMA is eager to achieve even more. Up next, we'll dive into the exciting new content planned for the coming month. Buckle up; we're venturing into uncharted territory!

[b][h3]Main Character Enhancement[/h3][/b]
Since our [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2646460/view/6189715263295870592]"Design of Beginning Charactersr"[/url][/b] post, we've been contemplating the best approach to tackle the main character issue.

The first step, of course, is to strengthen our starter character—they should be as capable as any ordinary tribesman.

In the upcoming major update, the starter character will be reclassified as an outcast with moderate rarity. Similar to other tribesmen, they will acquire unique talents as they level up—special survival skills honed from escaping sacrificial rituals and tribal wars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/683bf7f83379b07c62b24d99796db0e232d0355c.jpg[/img]
We’ve also increased the proficiency cap for the starter character. They may not match the experts in the tribe, but they’re definitely capable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/92c78351095c043740e6edef0108d670025b488e.jpg[/img]
We remain committed to crafting the "ultimate solution" for our protagonist. Thankfully, we have an enthusiastic community of chiefs who continuously inspire us with your ideas! Your contributions have significantly streamlined this process. Today, we're thrilled to unveil our final design: [i][b]Data Replication.[/b][/i]

[b][h3]Data Replication[/h3][/b]
[i]From the Mysterious Stone Table, the chieftain not only discovered how to enter their tribesmen's DNA information but also uncovered a magical function within it: using this entered genetic data to transform chieftain’s ordinary body—ultimately inheriting all abilities of their tribesmen.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/3d64cb6515502f554531c3829d4889e35377f1ef.png[/img]
"Data Replication" is an exciting new feature coming in our next major update. By using mask energy and crystals, you can conduct a deep genetic scan of specific tribesmen and modify the starter character’s body with tribesmen’s genetic data. This process transfers their unique talents to the main character, allowing them to harness these abilities. With this feature, the main character can embody the skills of any tribe member, unlocking the mask’s ultimate potential.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/6c06899c25cab4178a5a76ab61728e575ae7561e.jpg[/img]
Note that due to the uniqueness of genes, this operation is [b]irreversible[/b]. The replicated tribesmen cannot be recorded again - Perhaps making them base guards would be a good idea?

[b][h3]Crafting from inventory[/h3][/b]
The enigmatic mask continues to reveal its mysterious powers. Recently, chiefs discovered that the mask can teleport raw materials needed for production from storage boxes to the workbench through spatial teleportation technology.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/c0cb49d3aca775a898a29e0dd22fbd9540fdb52a.jpg[/img]
In the upcoming month, we will be updating the global resource calling function. This enhancement allows chiefs to utilize materials from any storage box within the campfire's range while crafting. This improvement minimizes the need for constant trips between storage boxes—leave that task to the tribesmen who aren't wearing masks!

[b][h3]The Follower Squad[/h3][/b]
[i]A single follower is no longer sufficient for the increasingly intense battles. Our tribesmen have been trained in team combat tactics using the mask's data.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/8ec8b7ee06ed53bb03775aa201730fc8c4f98f7a.jpg[/img]
In this month's late update, we're introducing an adjustable coefficient for the "number of followers" in single-player mode and private servers. This new feature will allow you to send multiple tribesmen into battle. This is just the beginning for the tribesmen squad; we have plans to further expand its tactical potential in future updates. Stay tuned!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[b][h2]More?[/h2][/b]
We have an array of exciting changes lined up for our major July update. While we can't detail everything due to the length constraints of this post, I can assure you that July will be a transformative month for Soulmask.

And this is just the beginning. We know there are still many issues with Soulmask that need to be addressed, such as the cheating problem that everyone is complaining about—we will share our progress on ensuring fair play later on—or the longstanding issues like interface usability and sound effects.

We are aware of these issues and are working diligently to resolve them. We will share our progress with you as soon as possible. A glorious civilization isn't built in a day, but that day is not too far off.
You’ll soon be able to experience all of this and more. Stay tuned for updates from Soulmask. I'm Maggie, and we'll see you in the next developer’s log!

notes.title: Soulmask Early Access Regular Update 11
notes.content:
Dear Chieftains,

To provide a better gaming experience, the server will undergo maintenance. It will be temporarily unavailable starting from July 11, at 7:00 AM UTC, with an expected downtime of 30 minutes. This update includes a client update, and chieftains will need to update their client to enjoy the game normally. We are very grateful for your understanding and support.

The update details are as follows:

[h3][Gameplay and Function Adjustments][/h3]

Fresh Meats changed to recovering Satiety instantly from recovering Satiety over several seconds

The tribesmen cap that can be recorded in Solo and Private Server has been raised to 10

Optimized the action of using bandages. Can use bandages while squatting, and using bandages while falling down doesn't slow you down

Ironblood Guard - Sequence Protection's Crit Resist has changed from 8% to 20%

Ironblood Guard - Muscle Revival new effect: Charges the healing energy every 180 seconds in duration. Once entering the Near-death status, releases energy immediately to heal injuries

Nature Enlightenment can summon animals with ≤Awareness Level +10 instead of ≤Awareness Level
Optimized the clipping-check rule in placing Brewing Stand

In PVP Mode, you can plunder supplies from all kinds of tables directly after 20% of their durability is destroyed. We've added a reminder when it could be plundered

Audio-related Optimizations: Optimized the decay of the wave sound over distance to make it smoother. Added the sound effect for the Blizzard weather. Reduced the volume of the "Icy Cold" and "Extreme Cold" sound effects

Can put cups and bowls into Ice Cellar

"Decor Table" has been renamed "Mask Decor Table". The corresponding name at technology nodes has also been changed to avoid confusion

Mask module placement adjustments in dungeons: Lv.40 dungeons yield Nature Enlightenment's modules, and Lv.50 dungeons yield Ironblood Guard's modules

[h3][Bug Fixes][/h3]

Fixed the issue that Anti-Radiation Tower didn't work in some cases

Rectified the Satiety Bonus of Refined Ostrich Feed

Fixed the issue of gauntlet's mastery skill - Monkey Fist: After the skill was interrupted by rolling, could still stack the Crit Buff by using other skills to attack

Fixed the issue that when the barrack's Alarm was triggered, the alarm's sound effect was still on even after it was demolished

Fixed the issue that the caretaker tribesman for Bonfire couldn't auto-repair Groundspike, Peg Board, and other traps

Fixed the issue that the caretaker tribesman for Bonfire couldn't auto-repair Wooden Man

Fixed the issue that couldn't get the Sweet Home and Comfort buffs while under the stair

Fixed the issue that the dismissed tribesmen could still be deterred

Fixed the issue that the sound effect was still on after the execution action was interrupted

Fixed the issue that "Wasteland Wolf" of the Desert could be spawned in the Random Invasion event of Snow Mountain

Fixed the issue that the scanning laser of Central Core couldn't attack ultra-close targets

Fixed the abnormal electrical skill effect of mechanical beings. Now you can't use metal shields to block the electrical damage of mechanical beings anymore (not for wooden shields and bone shields)

Fixed the issue that Central Core Boss had a chance to get players stuck (knocks players inside its body airborne when releasing skills)

Fixed the issue that when the language was set as German/Portuguese, couldn't set the Craft Quantity properly when it was over 999

Fixed the anomaly of the Panther/Snow Leopard summoned by Nature Enlightenment

notes.title: Community Event Highlights: Scenic-Snapshot
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, chieftains![/h2]

We recently hosted a small screenshot party on our Discord channel, inviting everyone to share the most breathtaking views they've discovered in Soulmask. Curious to learn more about this event? Join our [url=https://discord.com/channels/1160486185840418927/1160537278456791052/1257973692646948944][b]Discord channel[/b][/url] for all the details

We've received submissions from nearly [b]170 players[/b], and WOW, the entries are incredible! Maggie couldn't wait to share these amazing moments with you:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/05b3212b164f1da7343aea4087a94118d49934b7.png[/img]
[h3][b]Winners:[/b][/h3]

Let's start with the top three favorites among players!

[b]3rd Place: "Candlelight Dinner" by Pharodex ($10 Steam Gift Card)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/8665080f3db73a8a8e6d0fc8f69e212110d16a9d.jpg[/img]
[i]A tranquil jungle night, surrounded by fireflies, enjoying a romantic candlelit dinner. A serene glimpse into Soulmask's quieter, more beautiful side.[/i]

[b]2nd Place: "Finding Bathing Beauty" by Thaliyah ($15 Steam Gift Card)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/6c4b0156e92dd1720caf5ab3f2283939e66f2f0c.png[/img]
[i]After battling for survival, what could be more refreshing than taking a leap of faith off a majestic waterfall into crystal-clear waters below to take a bath? It's an unparalleled experience, only in Soulmask![/i]

[b]1st Place: "The Soulmask Evolution" by DaryRakiro ($20 Steam Gift Card)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/15f5524f65f9de6af0300d6451b1c94a82e66064.jpg[/img]
[i]Our grand champion! From beasts to barbarians, and ultimately to a chieftain leading a leap in civilization. Outstanding work, DaryRakiro! You've captured the essence of "Soulmask" in a single image: the evolution of civilization.[/i]

[h3][b]Honorable Mentions:[/b][/h3]

Beyond the top three, there are many imaginative and stunning images from other players that deserve recognition!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/bea550330623504ad66a2b5908fd12c3a5df0af8.jpg[/img]
[i][b]Archangel[/b] showcases lakes, dense forests, volcanoes, and vast clouds — enticing chieftains to explore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705810/bde2acbe2ff9ec3ffda7e9a208deb28e757559bf.jpg[/img]
[b]austin397[/b] found the perfect spot to witness the sunrise: amidst majestic stone forest.

To provide a better gaming experience, the server will undergo maintenance. It will be temporarily unavailable starting from July 4, at 7:00 AM UTC, with an expected downtime of 30 minutes.
